# nib_motion & nib_components — LLM Reference

> This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention: a single,
> information-dense Markdown document intended to be read by an LLM/coding
> agent before it generates Flutter code against these packages. It is not a
> human tutorial — it assumes Flutter fluency and favors exact signatures and
> runnable snippets over prose.

## What This Is

Two sibling Dart/Flutter packages, published independently to pub.dev and
developed together in the same monorepo:

| Package | pub.dev | Path (this monorepo) | Version | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nib_motion` | [pub.dev/packages/nib_motion](https://pub.dev/packages/nib_motion) | `MotionNib/motion/` | 0.3.4 (candidate source; 0.3.3 hosted) | A declarative, physics-based animation framework for Flutter. Zero pub dependencies beyond the Flutter SDK. |
| `nib_components` | [pub.dev/packages/nib_components](https://pub.dev/packages/nib_components) | `ComponetsNib/nib_components/` | 0.2.2 (candidate source; 0.2.1 hosted) | A Flutter UI component library with 30+ theme-aware widgets built on `nib_motion`. |

`nib_components` depends on `nib_motion` (`^0.3.1`) — installing
`nib_components` pulls `nib_motion` in transitively. You can also use
`nib_motion` completely standalone, on any Flutter widget, with no
`nib_components` dependency at all.

**Both are normal pub.dev packages, installed via `flutter pub add` and
imported directly.** Nothing here is copy-pasted by a CLI into your project —
if you encounter older documentation describing a shadcn/ui-style "registry" + `nib add <component>` CLI
that copies component source into your app, that describes an **abandoned,
earlier design**. It was scrapped 2026-07-10 in favor of the two real,
installable packages described in this file. Do not follow that model.

## Installation

```bash
# Animation framework only
flutter pub add nib_motion

# Component library (pulls in nib_motion automatically)
flutter pub add nib_components
```

```dart
import 'package:nib_motion/nib_motion.dart';
import 'package:nib_components/nib_components.dart'; // if using components
```

The current motion source requires Flutter 3.29 or newer for its shader
APIs. Its hosted 0.3.3 pubspec still advertises an older floor; the correction
is staged locally for a future patch. Use Flutter 3.29+ when generating code
against either the current source or the hosted motion archive.

## Design Philosophy

- **Physics over curves, by default.** Most transitions in both packages
  default to real spring simulations (`NibSpringDescription` presets:
  `gentle`/`snappy`/`wobbly`/`stiff`) rather than fixed-duration curves. You
  can always override with a curve-based `NibTransition(duration:, curve:)`
  instead.
- **No forced rebuilds for animation.** `nib_motion`'s core primitive,
  `MotionValue`, drives a `RenderObject` directly via `markNeedsPaint` —
  animating a `NibMotion` widget never calls `setState`. When building your
  own animated widgets on top of these packages, preserve this property;
  don't wrap `NibMotion` in something that rebuilds every frame.
- **Stateful-by-default, controller-optional** (`nib_components`). Every
  component works with zero wiring — pass plain parameters and it manages its
  own internal state. Reach for a `Nib<Component>Controller` only when you
  need to drive it imperatively from outside.
- **Theme-aware, light/dark by default.** `nib_components` reads all colors
  and radii from `NibTheme` (a `ThemeExtension`); components work
  out-of-the-box without registering it (falls back to `NibTheme.light`/
  `.dark` by ambient `Brightness`).
- **Animation is opt-in per component** (`nib_components`). Every component
  takes `animated: bool = false`. When `false`, it builds **zero**
  `NibMotion` widgets — not just "animation disabled," literally absent from
  the tree.


---

# nib_motion API Reference

Declarative, physics-based Flutter animation framework (Framer-Motion style), zero pub dependencies. Package root: `lib/nib_motion.dart`.

## Core Concepts

**MotionValue<T>** (`lib/src/values/motion_value.dart`) is a `ChangeNotifier` + `ValueListenable<T>` holding one animatable value. Setting `.value` notifies listeners synchronously only if the value actually changed. It is the single reactive primitive the whole package is built on: animation drivers (`SpringSolver`, `InertiaSolver`, raw `Ticker`s) write into a `MotionValue` every tick, and render objects (`RenderNibMotion` and friends) read it directly during `paint()`. `DerivedMotionValue<S,T>` (via `.transform()`/`.mapRange()`) recomputes reactively from a source `MotionValue`, and is itself chainable.

**NibAnim** (`lib/src/core/nib_anim.dart`) is an immutable snapshot of every property `NibMotion` can animate (x, y, scale/scaleX/scaleY, rotate, skewX/skewY, opacity, color, borderRadius, boxShadow) — the "what to animate to". Every field is nullable, and `null` means "this animation doesn't touch this property", not "reset to identity". `NibAnim.identity` is the only place defaults live; `.lerp()` falls back to `identity`'s value per-property only when interpolating between a set and unset side. `.merge()` (non-null-overrides) is how the Variants system cascades a child's resolved variant state over its parent's.

**NibTransition** (`lib/src/core/nib_transition.dart`) is the "how" — either curve-based tweening (`duration` + `curve`) or real spring physics (`spring: NibSpringDescription`, via `SpringSolver`/`flutter/physics.dart`'s `SpringSimulation`). Setting `spring` makes `type` resolve to `NibTransitionType.spring` and `duration`/`curve` are ignored. It also carries `delay`, `delayChildren`, and `staggerChildren` for stagger timing. `NibAnim` and `NibTransition` are deliberately separate — "what" vs "how" never mix.

**Propagation via InheritedWidget scopes, not props.** Several cross-cutting features use ancestor scopes a `NibMotion` reads instead of prop-drilling: `VariantsScope` (internal, not exported — created by `NibMotion.build`) propagates a `String` variant name plus stagger timing to descendants whose `variants` map has a matching key and no explicit `animate`; `NibPresenceScope` (internal) lets a `NibMotion` with `exit` register/unregister with the nearest ancestor `NibPresence` so its exit animation plays before removal; `NibMotionReplayScope` (exported) lets `NibScreenStack` (and any custom code) force entrance animations to replay, e.g. on tab revisit.

**Zero-rebuild animation is the load-bearing performance property of the entire package.** `NibMotion` owns one `MotionValue<double|Color?|BorderRadius?|List<BoxShadow>?>` per property, handed straight to `RenderNibMotion` (a `RenderProxyBox`). Animating never calls `setState` — a `MotionValue` notification calls `markNeedsPaint()` (and `markNeedsCompositingBitsUpdate()` for opacity) directly on the render object. Every other primitive in the package (`NibDraggable`, `NibPinch`, `NibShimmer`, `NibDrawPath`, `NibNavBar`'s `CustomPainter`, etc.) follows the identical pattern: a `MotionValue` written by a `Ticker`/`SpringSolver`/gesture callback, read directly in `paint()`. The only sanctioned exceptions are `NibTypewriter` (a discrete content value, not a per-frame paint value) and `NibPerfOverlay` (updates ~1Hz from `SchedulerBinding.addTimingsCallback`, not a member of the 60-120fps pipeline).

**Reduced motion & startup warm-up.** `NibMotionConfig` (in `core/reduced_motion.dart`) resolves reduced-motion via `setReducedMotion` override > `NibMotionConfig.reducedMotion` > `MediaQuery.disableAnimations`; when true, `NibMotion` jumps straight to the target with `setImmediately`. `NibMotionConfig.entranceWarmup` (400ms default) delays entrance animations (`animate`/`keyframes` on first build) so they don't run unseen under a native splash screen; `NibMotionGate.hold()`/`release()` extends that hold indefinitely for apps using `flutter_native_splash` in "preserve" mode.

## Widget/API Reference

### core

#### `NibMotion` (`nib_motion_widget.dart`)
The central animated widget — owns a `MotionValue` per property and drives it via spring/tween.
- `initial: Object?` — `NibAnim` or variant-name `String`; starting state (default `NibAnim.identity`)
- `animate: Object?` — `NibAnim` or variant-name `String`; target state. `null` with `variants` set means "inherit from ancestor `VariantsScope`"
- `exit: NibAnim?` — played by an ancestor `NibPresence` before removal. **Requires non-null `key`** (constructor `assert`)
- `whileTap`, `whileHover`, `whileFocus`, `whileDrag: NibAnim?` — gesture-state overrides; priority `drag > tap > hover > focus > none`
- `drag: NibDragConfig?` — enables dragging when non-null
- `whileInView: NibAnim?`, `viewport: NibInViewConfig?` — scroll-triggered animation
- `variants: NibVariants?` — named `NibAnim` map for `initial`/`animate` string lookup and inheritance
- `keyframes: List<NibKeyframe>?` — multi-step entrance overriding `initial`/`animate`; spring transitions unsupported with keyframes
- `motionValues: NibMotionValues?` — external `MotionValue` overrides, bypassing spring/tween per-property
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default `NibMotionConfig.defaultTransitionOf(context)` if null
- `controller: NibMotionController?` — imperative external driver
- `repeatAnimationInLoop: bool = false` — forever ping-pong `initial ⇄ animate`
- `child: Widget` required
```dart
NibMotion(
  initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: 24),
  animate: const NibAnim(opacity: 1, y: 0),
  whileTap: const NibAnim(scale: 0.95),
  transition: NibTransition.springSnappy,
  child: const Card(child: Text('Hello')),
)
```
Gotcha: `exit` without a `key` throws an assertion. Spring transitions ignore `keyframes` entirely (curve-only).

#### `NibAnim` (`nib_anim.dart`)
Immutable snapshot: `x, y, scale, scaleX, scaleY, rotate, skewX, skewY` (`double?`), `opacity: double?`, `color: Color?`, `borderRadius: BorderRadius?`, `boxShadow: List<BoxShadow>?`. All default `null` (untouched). `static const identity` sets every transform/opacity field to its neutral value. Methods: `lerp(other, t)`, `copyWith({...})`, `merge(other)` (other's non-null wins).

#### `NibTransition` (`nib_transition.dart`)
- `duration: Duration = 300ms`, `curve: Curve = Curves.easeInOut`, `delay: Duration = Duration.zero`
- `spring: NibSpringDescription?` — non-null switches `type` to `.spring`
- `delayChildren: Duration = Duration.zero`, `staggerChildren: Duration = Duration.zero`
- Static presets: `springGentle`, `springSnappy`, `springWobbly` (each just sets `spring:`)
- `NibTransitionType` enum: `tween`, `spring`

#### `NibKeyframe` / `computeAnimFromKeyframes` (`nib_keyframe.dart`)
`NibKeyframe({required at: double, required value: NibAnim, curve: Curve?})` — one point in a `NibMotion.keyframes` sequence; `curve` styles the segment *into* this keyframe. `computeAnimFromKeyframes(keyframes, t, defaultCurve) → NibAnim` is the top-level interpolation function (sorts by `at` if needed, binary-searches the surrounding pair, lerps).
```dart
NibMotion(
  keyframes: const [
    NibKeyframe(at: 0.0, value: NibAnim(y: -60, opacity: 0)),
    NibKeyframe(at: 0.6, value: NibAnim(y: 0, opacity: 1)),
    NibKeyframe(at: 1.0, value: NibAnim(y: 0)),
  ],
  child: const Text('Bounced in'),
)
```

#### `NibMotionController` (`nib_motion_controller.dart`)
Imperative multi-widget driver — attach the same controller to several `NibMotion`s via `controller:`.
- `start({NibAnim? target, List<NibKeyframe>? keyframes, NibTransition? transition}) → Future<void>` — exactly one of `target`/`keyframes`, or neither to replay entrance
- `set(NibAnim target)` — immediate, no animation
- `stop()` — freezes in place
- `repeat([bool enabled = true])` — toggles the ping-pong loop at runtime
- `sequence(List<NibMotionSequenceStep> steps) → Future<void>` — runs steps in order, awaiting each's animation + optional `wait`
- `NibMotionSequenceStep({required target: NibAnim, transition: NibTransition?, wait: Duration?})`
```dart
final controller = NibMotionController();
ElevatedButton(onPressed: () => controller.start(target: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: -20)), child: const Text('Hide'));
NibMotion(controller: controller, animate: const NibAnim(opacity: 1, y: 0), child: const Text('Target'));
// dispose controller in State.dispose()
```
Gotcha: must call `controller.dispose()` yourself — it's a plain `ChangeNotifier`, not owned by any `NibMotion`.

#### `NibMotionGate` (`nib_motion_gate.dart`)
`abstract final class` — global `static ValueNotifier<bool> ready` (default `true`). `hold()` freezes all entrance animations at frame 0; `release()` lets them proceed; `reset()` (tests only) restores default.
```dart
void main() {
  NibMotionGate.hold();
  runApp(const MyApp());
}
// after FlutterNativeSplash.remove():
NibMotionGate.release();
```

#### `NibMotionProvider` (`nib_motion_provider.dart`)
Thin `StatelessWidget` wrapper over `NibMotionConfig` for app-root configuration.
- `child: Widget` required, `defaultTransition: NibTransition = NibTransition()`, `respectReducedMotion: bool = true`, `debug: bool = false` (reserved, not wired)
```dart
runApp(NibMotionProvider(defaultTransition: NibTransition.springGentle, child: const MyApp()));
```

#### `NibMotionConfig` (`reduced_motion.dart`)
`InheritedWidget` — `reducedMotion: bool?`, `defaultTransition: NibTransition = NibTransition()`, `entranceWarmup: Duration = 400ms`, `child` required. Statics: `maybeOf(context)`, `shouldReduceMotion(context)`, `defaultTransitionOf(context)`, `remainingWarmup(context)`, `setReducedMotion(bool?)` (test override), `resetAppStartTime()` (test), `globalDefaultTransition`/`reducedMotionEnabled` getters, and `static Future<void> init({preloadShaders = true, defaultTransition = const NibTransition(), respectReducedMotion = true})` — call once before `runApp` to preload bundled shaders and set process-wide defaults.
```dart
void main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  await NibMotionConfig.init(defaultTransition: NibTransition.springGentle);
  runApp(const MyApp());
}
```

#### `NibMotionReplayScope` / `NibMotionReplaySignal` (`nib_motion_replay_scope.dart`)
`NibMotionReplaySignal extends ChangeNotifier` — `lastReplayDelay: Duration`, `replay({Duration delay = Duration.zero})`. `NibMotionReplayScope extends InheritedNotifier<NibMotionReplaySignal>` — `static maybeOf(context)`. Descendant `NibMotion`s with an entrance animation listen and replay when fired.

#### `NibMotionValues` (`nib_motion_values.dart`)
Immutable bag of optional external `MotionValue`s (`opacity, translateX, translateY, scaleX, scaleY, rotate, skewX, skewY, color, borderRadius, boxShadow`) to feed `NibMotion.motionValues`. Any non-null field is read-but-never-owned by `NibMotion` — caller must dispose it.
```dart
NibMotion(
  motionValues: NibMotionValues(opacity: bridge.scrollY.mapRange([0, 200], [1.0, 0.0])),
  child: const HeaderBar(),
)
```

#### `RenderNibMotion` (`render_nib_motion.dart`)
`RenderProxyBox` most consumers never instantiate directly — it's `NibMotion`'s internal paint layer, exposed publicly for advanced/testing use. Exposes settable `opacity/translateX/translateY/scaleX/scaleY/rotate/skewX/skewY/color/borderRadius/boxShadow` (`MotionValue`s), and a `transform` getter (the composed `Matrix4`). Paint order: opacity → transform → shadow → color fill → clip → child.

### values (`lib/src/values/`)

#### `MotionValue<T>` (`motion_value.dart`)
`MotionValue(T initial)`; `value` getter/setter (no-op-notify if unchanged); `hasListeners`; `transform<R>(R Function(T) mapper) → DerivedMotionValue<T,R>`. Top-level `motionValue<T>(initial) → MotionValue<T>` factory. Extension `MotionValueMapRange` on `MotionValue<double>`: `.mapRange(List<double> inputRange, List<double> outputRange, {bool clamp = true}) → DerivedMotionValue<double,double>` — linear piecewise map, needs ≥2 stops, clamps by default outside range.
```dart
final scrollY = motionValue<double>(0);
final opacity = scrollY.mapRange([0, 200], [1.0, 0.0]);
```

#### `DerivedMotionValue<S,T>` (`derived_motion_value.dart`)
`extends MotionValue<T>`; created via `.transform()`/`.mapRange()`. Recomputes and re-notifies whenever its source changes; chainable since it's itself a `MotionValue`. `dispose()` removes its source listener.

#### `ColorMotionValue` / `BoxShadowMotionValue` (`motion_value_types.dart`)
Typedefs: `MotionValue<Color?>` and `MotionValue<List<BoxShadow>?>`.

### physics (`lib/src/physics/`)

#### `NibSpringDescription` (`spring_description.dart`)
`{mass = 1.0, stiffness = 100.0, damping = 10.0}`. Presets: `gentle` (120/14), `snappy` (300/20), `wobbly` (180/12), `stiff` (400/28). `.toFlutter() → flutter_physics.SpringDescription`.

#### `SpringSolver` (`spring_solver.dart`)
`{required vsync: TickerProvider, required value: MotionValue<double>, required spring: NibSpringDescription, onComplete: VoidCallback?}`. `animateTo({required target, from, initialVelocity = 0})` — if a simulation is already running and no `initialVelocity` is given, continuity is preserved (continues from the outgoing sim's current velocity/position). `velocity` getter, `stop()`, `dispose()`.
Gotcha (general awareness): the `SpringSimulation` this drives resolves `onComplete`/any `animateTo`-derived `Future` only once `SpringSimulation.isDone()` passes Flutter's tight default `Tolerance` (distance & velocity < 0.001) — this can take ~0.5-1s *longer* than the animation looks visually settled. Don't gate perceptual "done" UI on `NibMotion.animateTo()`'s Future for a spring transition; only use it for chaining subsequent animations.

#### `InertiaSolver` (`inertia_solver.dart`)
`{required vsync, required value: MotionValue<double>, drag = 0.135, onComplete}` — `FrictionSimulation`-driven coast-to-stop (0.135 matches iOS scroll deceleration). `animateTo({required velocity})`, `stop()`, `dispose()`.

### gestures (`lib/src/gestures/`)
Only `NibDragConfig` and `NibDragReleaseMode` are exported from `drag_handler.dart` (its `DragHandler` class and `applyElastic` function are package-internal).

#### `NibDragConfig` (`drag_handler.dart`)
`{axis: Axis?, constraints: Rect?, elastic = false, elasticFactor = 0.2, onDragStart, onDragEnd: void Function(Velocity)?, releaseMode = NibDragReleaseMode.springBack, snapPoints: List<Offset>?}`. `NibDragReleaseMode`: `springBack | inertia | stay`. Feeds `NibMotion.drag`. In candidate 0.3.4, release velocity uses receiver-local pixels/second, matching the drag offset under transformed ancestors.

#### `NibDraggable` (`nib_draggable.dart`)
Standalone drag widget (no `NibMotion` integration) — `{required child, axis, bounds, snapBack = false, snapTarget, onDragStart, onDragUpdate, onDragEnd, spring = NibSpringDescription.gentle}`. Candidate 0.3.4 reports release velocity in receiver-local pixels/second.
```dart
NibDraggable(
  bounds: const Rect.fromLTWH(-100, -100, 200, 200),
  snapBack: true,
  child: const FlutterLogo(size: 64),
)
```

#### `NibPinch` (`nib_pinch.dart`)
`{required child, minScale = 0.5, maxScale = 4.0, initialScale = 1.0, snapBackOnRelease = false, onScaleChanged, spring = NibSpringDescription.gentle}`.

#### `NibSwipeDismiss` (`nib_swipe_dismiss.dart`)
`{required child, required onDismissed: VoidCallback, dismissThreshold = 0.5, dismissDirection = DismissDirection.horizontal, background: Widget?, spring = NibSpringDescription.gentle}`. `DismissDirection`: `horizontal | vertical | startToEnd | endToStart`.
```dart
NibSwipeDismiss(
  onDismissed: () => setState(() => items.removeAt(i)),
  background: Container(color: Colors.red),
  child: ListTile(title: Text(items[i])),
)
```

### layout (`lib/src/layout/`)

#### `NibLayoutGroup` (`nib_layout_group.dart`)
FLIP (First-Last-Invert-Play) auto-animate for position changes. `{required children: List<Widget>, transition}` — default `NibTransition.springGentle`. **Every child needs a unique, non-null `Key`.** Newly added children mount without a FLIP animation; removed keys stop being tracked.
```dart
NibLayoutGroup(
  transition: NibTransition.springSnappy,
  children: [for (final item in sortedItems) ListTile(key: ValueKey(item.id), title: Text(item.name))],
)
```

### list (`lib/src/list/`)

#### `NibMotionList` (`nib_motion_list.dart`)
`{required children, initial, animate, exit, variants, staggerDelay = 50ms, staggerDirection = NibStaggerDirection.forward, transition, controller, presenceEnabled = false}`. Wraps each child in `NibMotion`, offsetting `NibTransition.delay` by `staggerDelay * index`. If `presenceEnabled`, wraps in `NibPresence` (every child then needs a unique `Key`); otherwise lays out in a `Column`. `NibStaggerDirection`: `forward | reverse`.

### nav (`lib/src/nav/`)
The most widget-heavy corner — a full animated bottom-nav app shell.

#### `NibScaffold` (`nib_scaffold.dart`)
`{required screens: List<NibNavScreen>, required navItems: List<NibNavItem>` (equal length, asserted), `initialIndex = 0, onIndexChanged, navBarStyle, navIndicator, itemAnimation, screenTransition = NibNavScreenTransition(), floatingActionButton, navBarPosition = NibNavBarPosition.bottom, extendBodyBehindNavBar = false, backgroundColor, useMaterialScaffold = false, resizeToAvoidBottomInset = false}`. Owns the active tab index; every animation tick is `MotionValue`-driven except the single `setState` on tab change. `NibNavBarPosition`: `bottom | top`.

#### `NibScreenStack` (`nib_screen_stack.dart`)
`{required screens, required currentIndex, screenTransition = NibNavScreenTransition()}` — keeps every screen mounted (per `NibNavScreen.keepAlive`), animating outgoing+incoming simultaneously. `NibNavScreen({required child, keepAlive = true})`.

#### `NibNavBar` (`nib_nav_bar.dart`)
`{required items: List<NibNavItem>, required currentIndex, required onIndexChanged, style = NibNavBarStyle.standard, indicator = NibNavIndicatorStyle(), itemAnimation = NibNavItemAnimation()}`. Indicator/background driven by `SpringSolver`s into a `CustomPainter`; icons are real `Icon` widgets layered on top (not canvas-rasterized) for crisp scaling.

#### `NibNavItem` / `NibNavBadge` (`nib_nav_item.dart`)
`NibNavItem({required icon, activeIcon, label, badge, tooltip})` + `copyWith`. `NibNavBadge({count, color, textColor})` — `count: null` = dot, `0` = hidden, `>99` capped at "99+".

#### `NibNavBarStyle` / `NibNavIndicatorStyle` / `NibNavItemAnimation` (`nib_nav_style.dart`)
Value classes with full `copyWith`/`==`/`hashCode`. `NibNavBarStyle`: `backgroundColor, activeColor, inactiveColor, height=64, padding, margin, elevation=0, borderRadius, border, iconSize=24, labelStyle, glass=false, glassTint, glassBlur=8, glassHighlight=0.7` (static `standard`). `NibNavIndicatorStyle`: `type = NibNavIndicatorType.pill, color, height, width, borderRadius, spring = NibSpringDescription.snappy` (static `none`). `NibNavIndicatorType`: `liquid | pill | dot | line | highlight | none`; `liquid` uses a water shader where supported and a gradient fallback, and honours reduced motion. `NibNavItemAnimation`: `whileTap = NibAnim(scale: 0.85), whileActive = NibAnim(scale: 1.1), tapTransition = NibTransition.springSnappy` (static `none` sets both anims null).

#### `NibNavBarPainter` (`nib_nav_bar_painter.dart`)
`CustomPainter` used internally by `NibNavBar` — exported for advanced customization but rarely instantiated directly.

#### `NibNavScreenTransition` / `NibNavTransitions` (`nib_nav_transition.dart`, `nib_nav_transitions.dart`)
`NibNavScreenTransition({type = NibNavTransitionType.fade, spring = NibSpringDescription.gentle, tween, retriggerPageAnimations = false, retriggerDelay = Duration.zero})` — statics `none`, `slide`, `fade`. `NibNavTransitionType`: `fade | slideHorizontal | slideVertical | scale | sharedAxis | none`. `NibNavTransitions.resolve(type, direction, screenSize) → (enterFrom, exitTo)` — static resolver, rarely called directly by consumers.

### path (`lib/src/path/`)

#### `NibDrawPath` / `NibDrawPathController` (`nib_draw_path.dart`)
`{required path: Path, strokeWidth = 2.0, color = black, strokeCap = round, duration = 1000ms, curve = easeOut, autoPlay = true, repeat = false, controller}`. **Does not integrate with `NibMotionController`** — use `NibDrawPathController` (`play()/pause()/restart()`) instead.
```dart
NibDrawPath(path: signaturePath, color: Colors.blue, strokeWidth: 3, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1200))
```

#### `NibPathMotion` / `NibPathMotionController` (`nib_path_motion.dart`)
`{required child, required path, progress: MotionValue<double>?, duration = 1000ms, curve = easeInOut, repeat = false, autoPlay = true, rotate = false, controller}`. If `progress` is supplied externally, `duration/curve/repeat/autoPlay` are ignored — caller drives it (e.g. from a `ScrollMotionBridge`). Own controller type, same reasoning as `NibDrawPath`.

### presence (`lib/src/presence/`)

#### `NibPresence` (`nib_presence.dart`)
`{required children: List<Widget>}`. **Every child must carry a non-null, unique `Key`.** Removed children stay mounted (wrapped `IgnorePointer`) until their `NibMotion.exit` finishes via the internal `NibMotionAnimator.triggerExit`, then are removed.
```dart
NibPresence(
  children: [for (final item in items) NibMotion(key: ValueKey(item.id), exit: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, x: -40), child: Tile(item))],
)
```
Gotcha: a child without `exit` set is removed instantly with no animation (its `triggerExit` future resolves immediately).

### presets (`lib/src/presets/`)
See table below for the ready-made widgets; `NibAnimPresets` (`nib_anim_presets.dart`) is the underlying data library: keyframe lists `shake`, `bounceIn`, `pulse`, `rubberBand`, `wiggle`, and single-state `NibAnim`s `fadeUp/fadeDown/fadeLeft/fadeRight/zoomIn/zoomOut`, usable directly with `NibMotion.keyframes`/`initial`.

### scroll (`lib/src/scroll/`)

#### `ScrollMotionBridge` (`scroll_motion_bridge.dart`)
`{required controller: ScrollController}` — mirrors `controller.offset` into `scrollY`/`scrollX` (`MotionValue<double>`), from which any animatable value can be derived via `.mapRange()`. Manual `dispose()` required.

#### `NibScrollMotion` (`nib_scroll_motion.dart`)
`{required controller, required builder: Widget Function(context, ScrollMotionBridge)}` — creates/disposes the bridge for you.
```dart
NibScrollMotion(
  controller: scrollController,
  builder: (context, bridge) => NibMotion(
    motionValues: NibMotionValues(opacity: bridge.scrollY.mapRange([0, 200], [1, 0])),
    child: const HeaderBar(),
  ),
)
```

#### `NibParallax` (`nib_parallax.dart`)
`{required child, required scrollController, factor = 0.5, axis = Axis.vertical}` — `factor: 0` pins in place, `1` scrolls 1:1 (no visible parallax). Does not need to be inside the tracked scroll view.

#### `NibScrollReveal` (`nib_scroll_reveal.dart`)
Thin `NibMotion.whileInView` convenience — `{required child, initial = NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: 32), animate = NibAnim.identity, transition, once = true, amount = 0.2}`.

### shaders (`lib/src/shaders/`)
Require Flutter's shader asset pipeline (`flutter.shaders` in the host `pubspec.yaml` matching `NibShaderAssets`'s paths); all degrade gracefully (child painted as-is, or with a plain opacity fallback) if the shader fails to compile.

#### `NibShaderLoader` / `NibShaderAssets` (`shader_loader.dart`)
Singleton cache — `shimmer()/dissolve()/gradientSweep()/liquidGlass() → Future<FragmentProgram>`, `preloadAll()` (swallows failures), `resetForTesting()`.

#### `NibShimmer` (`nib_shimmer.dart`)
`{required child, baseColor, shimmerColor, speed = 1.5, angle = -0.3, enabled = true}` — GPU diagonal sweep skeleton-loader effect.

#### `NibDissolve` (`nib_dissolve.dart`)
`{required child, duration = 500ms, direction = NibDissolveDirection.outward, noiseScale = 0.02, onComplete}`. `NibDissolveDirection`: `inward | outward`.

#### `NibGlass` (`nib_glass.dart`)
Liquid-glass surface. `{required child, borderRadius = circular(24), clipper, blurSigma = 1, tint = 0x14FFFFFF, thickness = 20, refractiveIndex = 1.2, chromaticAberration = 0.03, saturation = 1.3, highlight = 0.5, lightDirection = Offset(-0.5, -1)}`. True edge refraction needs the **Impeller** backend (`ui.ImageFilter.isShaderFilterSupported`); otherwise falls back to frosted blur + tint + painted rim. `static Future<bool> debugShaderPathAvailable()` for diagnostics.

### text (`lib/src/text/`)
`text/nib_text.dart` exports **only `NibText`** — `NibTextUnitData`, `splitGraphemes`, `splitTextIntoUnits`, and `computeStaggerDelay` are public in-file but not part of the package's public surface.

#### `NibTextConfig` (`nib_text_config.dart`)
`{unit = NibTextUnit.character, initial, animate, exit, staggerDelay = 30ms, staggerFrom = NibTextStaggerFrom.start, transition}`. `NibTextUnit`: `character | word | line`. `NibTextStaggerFrom`: `start | end | center | random`.

#### `NibText` (`nib_text.dart`)
`NibText(text, {config = NibTextConfig(), style, textAlign, overflow, controller})` and `NibText.rich(span, {...})`. Splits into per-unit `NibMotion`s reusing the core engine — never drives its own per-frame value.
```dart
NibText(
  'Welcome aboard',
  config: NibTextConfig(
    unit: NibTextUnit.word,
    initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: 12),
    animate: NibAnim.identity,
    staggerDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 60),
  ),
)
```
Gotcha: `NibText.rich`'s per-span styling within the `InlineSpan` is *not* preserved per-unit — only `style` (the flat base style) is.

#### `NibGradientText` (`nib_text_gradient.dart`)
`{required text: String, required gradient: Gradient, style, duration = 2000ms, repeat = true, direction = TextDirection.ltr}` — masks an animated gradient sweep onto painted glyph pixels via `BlendMode.srcIn`.

#### `NibTextReveal` (`nib_text_reveal.dart`)
`{required child, direction = NibTextRevealDirection.left, duration = 500ms, delay = Duration.zero, curve = easeInOut, controller}` — whole-block clip wipe (not per-character). `NibTextRevealDirection`: `left | right | up | down`.

#### `NibTypewriter` (`nib_typewriter.dart`)
`{required text: String, speed = 50ms, cursor = '|', cursorBlinkInterval = 530ms, style, onComplete, repeat = false, deleteSpeed, delay = Duration.zero}`. The one legitimate `setState`-per-tick widget in the package (discrete character count, driven by `Timer.periodic`, not a continuous paint value).

### timeline (`lib/src/timeline/`)

#### `NibAnimationSequence` (`nib_animation_sequence.dart`)
Fluent builder over one `NibMotionController`: `.animate(target, {transition})`, `.wait(duration)`, `.call(callback)`, `.loop([times])` (call at most once, before `.play()`; omitted `times` loops forever), `.play() → Future<void>` (never completes if looping forever), `.stop()`, `.dispose()`.
```dart
await NibAnimationSequence(controller)
  .animate(const NibAnim(y: -20, opacity: 0))
  .wait(const Duration(milliseconds: 100))
  .animate(const NibAnim(y: 0, opacity: 1), transition: NibTransition.springGentle)
  .play();
```

#### `NibTimeline` / `NibTimelineEntry` (`nib_timeline.dart`, `nib_timeline_entry.dart`)
`NibTimeline(List<NibTimelineEntry> entries)` — sorts by `at`, schedules each entry's `controller.start(target:, transition:)` via internal `Timer`s. `.play() → Future<void>` (completes once the last entry fires+finishes), `.pause()`/`.stop()` (cancel pending timers only), `.dispose()`. `NibTimelineEntry({required controller: NibMotionController, required target: NibAnim, required at: Duration, transition})`.
```dart
final timeline = NibTimeline([
  NibTimelineEntry(controller: titleController, target: const NibAnim(opacity: 1), at: Duration.zero),
  NibTimelineEntry(controller: subtitleController, target: const NibAnim(opacity: 1), at: const Duration(milliseconds: 150)),
]);
await timeline.play();
```

### variants (`lib/src/variants/`)
Only `nib_variants.dart` is exported — `VariantsScope`/`VariantsIndexCounter` (`variants_scope.dart`) are package-internal, driven automatically by `NibMotion`.

#### `NibVariants` (`nib_variants.dart`)
`typedef NibVariants = Map<String, NibAnim>` — named states `NibMotion.initial`/`.animate` resolve by name, and that descendants with their own `variants` react to via propagation.
```dart
const containerVariants = {'hidden': NibAnim(opacity: 0), 'visible': NibAnim(opacity: 1)};
NibMotion(variants: containerVariants, animate: 'visible', child: child); // propagates 'visible' to descendants
```

### viewport (`lib/src/viewport/`)

#### `NibInViewConfig` (`nib_in_view_config.dart`)
`{amount = 0.5 (0.0-1.0, asserted), once = false, margin = EdgeInsets.zero}` — configures `NibMotion.whileInView`'s visibility threshold.

### extensions (`lib/src/extensions/`)

#### `NibDurationExtension` on `int` (`duration_extensions.dart`)
`.ms → Duration(milliseconds: this)`, `.seconds → Duration(seconds: this)`.

#### `NibMotionWidgetExtension` on `Widget` (`widget_motion_extensions.dart`)
`.animate({initial, animate, exit, transition, whileTap, whileHover, key}) → NibMotion` (wraps `this` as `child`); `.shimmer({enabled = true}) → NibShimmer`; `.revealOnScroll({initial, once = true}) → NibScrollReveal` (default `initial: NibAnimPresets.fadeUp`).
```dart
const Text('Hi').animate(initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0), animate: NibAnim.identity);
myImage.shimmer();
const Text('Reveal me').revealOnScroll();
```

### debug (`lib/src/debug/`)

#### `NibMotionRegistry` (`motion_value_inspector.dart`)
Global debug-only singleton (`.instance`) mapping string id → `MotionValue`. `register(id, value)`/`unregister(id)`/`values` (unmodifiable snapshot) are all no-ops outside `kDebugMode` — zero production overhead.

#### `NibMotionDebugger` (`nib_motion_debugger.dart`)
`{required child, enabled = kDebugMode, showBoundingBoxes = true, showMotionValues = true, showFps = true}`. When `enabled: false`, `build()` returns `child` directly — a complete no-op passthrough with zero extra widgets. `showBoundingBoxes` is a simplified visual indicator (dashed-border marker), not true per-widget box tracing (documented engineering trade-off in source).
```dart
NibMotionDebugger(child: const MyApp()) // wrap app root during development
```

#### `NibPerfOverlay` (`nib_perf_overlay.dart`)
`{textStyle}` — live FPS readout via `SchedulerBinding.addTimingsCallback` (~1Hz updates, not per-frame).

## Presets quick table

| Widget | What it does | Key params |
|---|---|---|
| `NibBounce` | Drop-in-from-above + settle bounce entrance (`NibAnimPresets.bounceIn` keyframes) | `duration = 800ms` |
| `NibFlip` | 3D card flip revealing `back` in place of `front` | `isFlipped`, `duration = 600ms`, `flipAxis = horizontal` |
| `NibFloat` | Forever gentle up/down float (ping-pong loop) | `distance = 10px`, `duration = 1600ms` |
| `NibPulse` | Forever "heartbeat" scale pulse (`NibAnimPresets.pulse`, looped) | `duration = 900ms` |
| `NibRubberBand` | One-shot non-uniform overshoot-and-settle (`NibAnimPresets.rubberBand`) | `duration = 1000ms` |
| `NibShake` | Rapid left-right shake, triggered on demand via `NibShakeController.shake()` | `controller: NibShakeController?`, `duration = 600ms` |

`NibAnimPresets` (not a widget) additionally exposes raw data: keyframe lists `shake`, `bounceIn`, `pulse`, `rubberBand`, `wiggle`, and single `NibAnim`s `fadeUp/fadeDown/fadeLeft/fadeRight/zoomIn/zoomOut` for use with any `NibMotion.keyframes`/`initial`.

## Common Recipes

**Fade + slide entrance with stagger (list of cards):**
```dart
NibMotionList(
  initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: 24),
  animate: NibAnim.identity,
  staggerDelay: const Duration(milliseconds: 60),
  children: [for (final c in cards) CardTile(key: ValueKey(c.id), card: c)],
)
```

**Draggable card with spring snap-back:**
```dart
NibMotion(
  drag: const NibDragConfig(releaseMode: NibDragReleaseMode.springBack, elastic: true),
  whileDrag: const NibAnim(scale: 1.05),
  transition: NibTransition.springGentle,
  child: const CreditCard(),
)
```

**Bottom-nav app shell:**
```dart
NibScaffold(
  navItems: const [
    NibNavItem(icon: Icon(Icons.home), label: 'Home'),
    NibNavItem(icon: Icon(Icons.search), label: 'Search'),
  ],
  screens: const [NibNavScreen(child: HomeScreen()), NibNavScreen(child: SearchScreen())],
  screenTransition: const NibNavScreenTransition(type: NibNavTransitionType.sharedAxis),
)
```

**Scroll-linked parallax + fade header:**
```dart
final scrollController = ScrollController();
NibScrollMotion(
  controller: scrollController,
  builder: (context, bridge) => NibMotion(
    motionValues: NibMotionValues(opacity: bridge.scrollY.mapRange([0, 150], [1.0, 0.0])),
    child: const HeaderImage(),
  ),
)
// elsewhere: NibParallax(scrollController: scrollController, factor: 0.4, child: const BackgroundArt())
```

**Per-word text reveal on entrance:**
```dart
NibText(
  'Ship it.',
  config: NibTextConfig(
    unit: NibTextUnit.word,
    initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, y: 16),
    animate: NibAnim.identity,
    staggerFrom: NibTextStaggerFrom.start,
  ),
)
```

**Gesture-driven whileTap/whileHover button:**
```dart
NibMotion(
  whileTap: const NibAnim(scale: 0.92),
  whileHover: const NibAnim(scale: 1.05),
  transition: NibTransition.springSnappy,
  child: const ElevatedButtonLikeSurface(),
)
```

**Exit animation list (remove-with-animation):**
```dart
NibPresence(
  children: [
    for (final item in items)
      NibMotion(
        key: ValueKey(item.id),
        initial: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, x: 40),
        animate: NibAnim.identity,
        exit: const NibAnim(opacity: 0, x: -40),
        child: Tile(item),
      ),
  ],
)
```

**Variant-driven parent/child cascade:**
```dart
const menuVariants = {'closed': NibAnim(opacity: 0, scale: 0.9), 'open': NibAnim(opacity: 1, scale: 1)};
NibMotion(
  variants: menuVariants,
  animate: isOpen ? 'open' : 'closed',
  transition: const NibTransition(staggerChildren: Duration(milliseconds: 40)),
  child: Column(children: [for (final item in menuItems) NibMotion(variants: menuVariants, child: MenuRow(item))]),
)
```

## Known Pitfalls

- **`exit` requires a non-null `key`.** `NibMotion`'s constructor asserts this — `NibPresence` tracks widget identity across removal by `Key`.
- **Spring-driven Futures resolve later than the animation looks done.** `SpringSolver.animateTo()`/`NibMotion.animateTo()` (and anything chained through `NibMotionController.start`/`.sequence`) complete only once `SpringSimulation.isDone()` passes Flutter's tight default `Tolerance` (distance & velocity < 0.001) — this can trail the perceptual settle by ~0.5-1s. Only rely on these Futures for chaining subsequent animation steps, never to gate "animation finished" UI/interaction re-enabling.
- **`NibDrawPath`/`NibPathMotion` don't use `NibMotionController`.** They ship their own `NibDrawPathController`/`NibPathMotionController` (`play/pause/restart`) — passing a `NibMotionController` to them does nothing.
- **`NibText.rich` doesn't preserve per-span styling per-unit** — only the flat `style:` parameter applies to every split unit; mixed-style `TextSpan` children are flattened to plain text for splitting.
- **`text/nib_text.dart`'s only exported symbol is `NibText`** — `splitGraphemes`, `NibTextUnitData`, `splitTextIntoUnits`, `computeStaggerDelay` are public in the source file but not part of the package API (the barrel uses `show NibText`).
- **`gestures/drag_handler.dart` only exports `NibDragConfig`/`NibDragReleaseMode`** — `DragHandler` and `applyElastic` are internal; use `NibMotion.drag` or `NibDraggable`, not the handler directly.
- **`NibPresence` children without an `exit`** are removed from the tree instantly (their `triggerExit` Future resolves immediately with no animation) — set `exit` on every child you want to animate out.
- **Manual dispose responsibilities:** `NibMotionController`, `ScrollMotionBridge`, `NibShakeController`, `NibAnimationSequence`, `NibTimeline`, and any externally-owned `MotionValue` passed via `NibMotionValues`/`NibPathMotion.progress` are **not** disposed by the widgets that consume them — the creator must call `.dispose()`.
- **`TickerProvider` requirement:** almost every driver (`SpringSolver`, `InertiaSolver`, raw `Ticker`-based widgets like `NibDrawPath`/`NibFlip`/`NibShimmer`/`NibDissolve`/`NibGradientText`) needs a `vsync`; all the package's own `StatefulWidget`s already mix in `TickerProviderStateMixin`/`SingleTickerProviderStateMixin` — only relevant if you drive `SpringSolver`/`InertiaSolver` yourself outside a `NibMotion`.
- **Reduced-motion jump semantics:** when `NibMotionConfig.shouldReduceMotion(context)` is true, `NibMotion.animateTo`/keyframe playback/loop all jump straight to the target with `setImmediately` — no animation frames run at all (not just "faster"), so don't assume any transition frames exist for reduced-motion users.
- **Shader-backed widgets (`NibShimmer`, `NibDissolve`, `NibGlass`) degrade silently** if the host app hasn't declared `nib_motion`'s shader assets in its own `pubspec.yaml` `flutter.shaders`, or on a non-Impeller rendering backend for `NibGlass`'s true refraction path — they never throw, just fall back to a plain child paint (or blur, for `NibGlass`) with no dev-facing warning besides `NibGlass.debugShaderPathAvailable()`.
- **`NibLayoutGroup`/`NibPresence`/`NibMotionList` (with `presenceEnabled`) all require unique, non-null `Key`s** on every child — omitting one throws (`child.key!`).
- **`entranceWarmup` (400ms default) delays entrance animations from `NibMotion.initState`**, not just `NibMotionGate` — a widget built well after app start (e.g. on a pushed-later screen) is unaffected since the warmup window has already elapsed, but a widget built in the first frame will visibly wait before its `animate`/`keyframes` entrance begins.

---

# nib_components API Reference

Package: `nib_components` (Flutter). A native, installable widget library — NOT a
copy-paste CLI/registry (that model is abandoned/historical; ignore any docs at
`/home/occ/Projects/Nib/CLAUDE.md` describing it). Source: `/home/occ/Projects/Nib/ComponetsNib/nib_components/`.
Built on the sibling animation package `nib_motion` (`../../MotionNib/motion`, wired
in as a `path:` dependency pre-publish).

## Core Conventions

**Installation.** `flutter pub add nib_components` — this also pulls in `nib_motion`,
which every component's animation is built on. Import everything via the single public
barrel: `import 'package:nib_components/nib_components.dart';`. The barrel
(`lib/nib_components.dart`) re-exports every file under `lib/src/<component>/` except
the internal `lib/src/overlay/` support directory (shared anchored-overlay positioning
logic used by several overlay components — not part of the public API, see Known
Pitfalls).

**Theming — zero-config with opt-in customization.** Every component reads colors and
border radii exclusively through `NibTheme.of(context)`, never hardcoded hex values.
`NibTheme` is a `ThemeExtension<NibTheme>`; if the host app never registers it on
`ThemeData.extensions`, `NibTheme.of` falls back to the built-in `NibTheme.light` /
`NibTheme.dark` constant, chosen by the ambient `Theme.of(context).brightness`. To
customize, register the extension (typically `NibTheme.light`/`.dark` with
`.copyWith(...)` overrides) on both `theme:` and `darkTheme:`:

```dart
MaterialApp(
  theme: ThemeData(extensions: const [NibTheme.light]),
  darkTheme: ThemeData(extensions: const [NibTheme.dark]),
  home: const MyHome(),
);
```

**Stateful-by-default + optional controller.** Every component is a `StatefulWidget`
whose public constructor takes plain, simple parameters — no controller required for
basic use. All bookkeeping (loading/selection/sort/expansion/open-closed/etc.) lives in
the private `State` class. Components that benefit from external/programmatic control
additionally expose an optional `<Component>Controller` constructor parameter (a
`ChangeNotifier` subclass, e.g. `NibDataTableController`, `NibTabsController`,
`NibAccordionController`). When no controller is passed, the widget creates and owns
one internally and disposes it on unmount; when a controller *is* passed, the caller
owns it and is responsible for disposing it — the widget does not dispose a
caller-supplied controller. Passing a new controller instance to an already-mounted
widget (`didUpdateWidget`) correctly swaps and disposes the old internally-owned one if
applicable. Overlay-style APIs exposed as top-level `show...` functions (`showNibDialog`,
`showNibAlertDialog`, `showNibBottomSheet`, `showNibContextMenu`, `showNibToast`) are the
exception to "StatefulWidget with a controller" — they are imperative, `Future`-returning
functions similar to Flutter's own `showDialog`/`showModalBottomSheet`, not widgets
placed in the tree.

**Motion — `animated` + `transition`, built on `nib_motion`.** Every component that has
any enter/exit/state-change animation exposes `animated: bool = false` and, where more
than one visual transition style makes sense, a `transition: NibTransition?` parameter.
All animation routes exclusively through `nib_motion`'s primitives (`NibMotion`,
`NibShimmer`, etc.) — never Flutter's implicit-animation widgets
(`AnimatedContainer`/`AnimatedOpacity`/etc.). **When `animated: false`, the component
builds zero `NibMotion`-family widgets at all** — this is a hard architectural
invariant (verified in the source test suite with `find.byType(NibMotion), findsNothing`),
not merely "animation configured off." Treat `animated: true` as changing which widget
subtree gets built, not just a flag consumed by an animated widget that's always present.

**Responsive by default.** Components must not silently clip, overflow, or squish
content when the viewport is narrower than the content's natural size. The canonical
pattern (set by `NibDataTable`) is a `LayoutBuilder` that compares available width
against intrinsic content width and falls back to a scrollable axis
(`SingleChildScrollView`) rather than compressing content below a usable size. Expect
this pattern in table/tabs/toggle-group/breadcrumb-style components with
potentially-wide content.

**Naming.** All public widgets are `Nib`-prefixed PascalCase (`NibButton`, `NibCard`,
`NibDataTable`). Controllers: `Nib<Component>Controller`. Variant/type enums: no `Nib`
prefix by convention in some places but check per-component (this package is more
consistent about prefixing than the historical registry docs — verify exact enum names
in the Component Reference below, don't assume). Supporting value types are `Nib`-prefixed
(`NibDataColumn`, `NibSelectOption`, `NibBreadcrumbItem`, etc.).

## Component Reference

### accordion

Vertically stacked expandable sections with built-in single-open coordination (opening one closes the others, unlike `ExpansionTile`).

`NibAccordion(StatefulWidget)` constructor:
- `items: List<NibAccordionItem>` (required) — the sections
- `controller: NibAccordionController? = null` — external controller; internal one created/owned/disposed when null
- `allowMultipleOpen: bool = false` — allow more than one section open at once
- `defaultOpenIndex: int? = null` — index to start expanded (respects `allowMultipleOpen`)
- `animated: bool = false` — opt-in height reveal + chevron rotation via nib_motion
- `transition: NibTransition? = null` — null → `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 220))`
- `onExpansionChanged: void Function(int index, bool isOpen)? = null` — fired on user tap

`NibAccordionItem` (data class, not a widget):
- `title: Widget` (required)
- `content: Widget` (required)
- `leading: Widget? = null`
- `enabled: bool = true`

Controller — `NibAccordionController extends ChangeNotifier`:
- constructor: `NibAccordionController({Set<int>? initialOpen, bool allowMultiple = false})`
- `allowMultiple: bool` (mutable field, kept in sync with widget's `allowMultipleOpen`)
- `openIndices` (getter) — unmodifiable `Set<int>` snapshot of open sections
- `isOpen(int index) -> bool`
- `open(int index)` — opens; in single-open mode closes all others
- `close(int index)` — no-op if already closed
- `toggle(int index)`
- `openAll(int count)` — no-op unless `allowMultiple`
- `closeAll()`

Animation: `animated: true` wraps only the chevron icon in `NibMotion` (keyed by `open` state, rotating between `NibAnim(rotate: ±math.pi)` and `NibAnim.identity`); the height reveal itself is driven by a plain `AnimationController`/`ClipRect`+`Align(heightFactor:)`, not by NibMotion (height can't route through NibMotion's transform/opacity model). `animated: false` → chevron just snaps via `Transform.rotate`, zero `NibMotion` built.

Usage (adapted from `accordion_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibAccordion(
  allowMultipleOpen: true,
  animated: true,
  defaultOpenIndex: 0,
  items: const [
    NibAccordionItem(
      leading: Icon(Icons.local_shipping_outlined),
      title: Text('Shipping'),
      content: Text('Free standard shipping on orders over \$50.'),
    ),
    NibAccordionItem(
      leading: Icon(Icons.assignment_return_outlined),
      title: Text('Returns'),
      content: Text('30-day free returns.'),
    ),
  ],
)

// External controller
final controller = NibAccordionController(allowMultiple: true);
NibAccordion(controller: controller, allowMultipleOpen: true, items: faqItems);
controller.openAll(faqItems.length);
controller.closeAll();
```

---

### alert

Imperative confirm/alert popup (Flutter `AlertDialog` equivalent), built on `showNibDialog`. Not a placed widget — call the function to show a modal with title/message and Cancel/OK actions.

`Future<bool?> showNibAlertDialog(BuildContext context, { ... })` parameters:
- `title: String? = null`
- `description: String? = null`
- `content: Widget? = null` — replaces the built-in title/description/icon body; at least one of title/description/content is required (asserted)
- `severity: NibAlertSeverity? = null` — drives default icon + accent color
- `icon: Widget? = null` — overrides severity's default icon
- `iconColor: Color? = null`
- `titleTextStyle: TextStyle? = null`
- `descriptionTextStyle: TextStyle? = null`
- `confirmText: String = 'OK'`
- `cancelText: String? = 'Cancel'` — pass `null` for a single-button informational alert
- `onConfirm: VoidCallback? = null`
- `onCancel: VoidCallback? = null`
- `cancelVariant: NibButtonVariant = NibButtonVariant.outline`
- `confirmVariant: NibButtonVariant? = null` — null → `destructive` if `severity == error`, else `primary`
- `buttonPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? = null`
- `buttonWidth: double? = null` — forces both buttons to identical width
- `cancelFirst: bool = true` — left-to-right order
- `actions: List<Widget>? = null` — fully replaces the default Cancel/OK `OverflowBar` row; use `NibDialogScope.of(ctx).close(result)` inside each action
- `actionsAlignment: MainAxisAlignment = MainAxisAlignment.end`
- `actionsSpacing: double = 12`
- `actionsOverflowAlignment: OverflowBarAlignment = OverflowBarAlignment.end`
- `actionsOverflowDirection: VerticalDirection = VerticalDirection.down`
- `barrierDismissible: bool = true`
- `adaptive: bool = false` — iOS/macOS Cupertino-style presentation (centered text, full-width divided text actions) when running on iOS/macOS; Material otherwise regardless of platform
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition? = null`

Returns: `true` on confirm tap, `false` on cancel tap, `null` if dismissed via barrier/Escape.

No controller (imperative function API — the returned `Future` plays that role).

`animated`/`transition` forward directly into `showNibDialog`'s own animation.

Related types — `nib_alert_types.dart`:
- `enum NibAlertSeverity { info, success, warning, error }`
- extension `NibAlertSeverityX on NibAlertSeverity`: `defaultIcon() -> IconData`, `accent(NibTheme theme) -> Color` (info→theme.accent, success→`0xFF16A34A` constant, warning→`0xFFF59E0B` constant, error→theme.destructive)

Usage (adapted from `alert_examples.dart`):
```dart
final confirmed = await showNibAlertDialog(
  context,
  title: 'Delete file?',
  description: 'This cannot be undone.',
  severity: NibAlertSeverity.error,
  confirmText: 'Delete',
  buttonWidth: 110,
);
if (confirmed == true) { /* delete */ }

// Single-button informational alert
await showNibAlertDialog(
  context,
  title: 'Update available',
  description: 'Version 2.0 is ready to install.',
  severity: NibAlertSeverity.info,
  cancelText: null,
);

// Custom actions row
final confirmed = await showNibAlertDialog(
  context,
  title: 'Replace existing file?',
  description: 'A file with this name already exists.',
  actions: [
    Builder(builder: (ctx) => NibButton(
      label: 'Keep both',
      variant: NibButtonVariant.ghost,
      onPressed: () => NibDialogScope.of(ctx).close(false),
    )),
    Builder(builder: (ctx) => NibButton(
      label: 'Replace',
      variant: NibButtonVariant.destructive,
      onPressed: () => NibDialogScope.of(ctx).close(true),
    )),
  ],
);
```

---

### bottom_sheet

Modal bottom sheet with optional multi-height "snap points" and drag-to-dismiss, offered as both a declarative trigger widget (`NibBottomSheet`) and an imperative function (`showNibBottomSheet`)/lower-level primitive (`openNibBottomSheet`).

**`NibBottomSheet` (StatefulWidget)** — declarative trigger, matches `NibDialog`/`NibSelect` house style:
- `trigger: Widget? = null` — tapping opens the sheet; omit and drive via `controller` instead
- `controller: NibBottomSheetController? = null`
- `content: Widget` (required)
- `title: String? = null`
- `snapPoints: List<double>? = null` — fractions (0..1) of available height; omit for a content-sized sheet
- `initialSnap: int? = null` — index into `snapPoints`; defaults to the most-open snap
- `onSnapChanged: ValueChanged<int>? = null`
- `dismissible: bool = true`
- `showDragHandle: bool = true`
- `barrierColor: Color? = null` — default `Color(0x73000000)`
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition? = null`
- `onClose: VoidCallback? = null`

**`showNibBottomSheet<T>(BuildContext context, { ... }) -> Future<T?>`** — imperative, fire-and-forget, returns a future resolving with the result (`null` if dismissed):
- `content: Widget` (required)
- `title: String? = null`
- `snapPoints: List<double>? = null`
- `initialSnap: int? = null`
- `onSnapChanged: ValueChanged<int>? = null`
- `dismissible: bool = true`
- `showDragHandle: bool = true`
- `barrierColor: Color? = null`
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition? = null`
- `onClose: VoidCallback? = null`

**`openNibBottomSheet<T>(BuildContext context, { same params as showNibBottomSheet }) -> NibBottomSheetHandle<T>`** — lower-level primitive both of the above are built on; inserts into the root `Overlay` and returns a handle instead of a bare future. Prefer `showNibBottomSheet` unless you need `snapTo`/`close` from outside the content.

`NibBottomSheetHandle<T>`:
- `closed: Future<T?>` (getter)
- `isOpen: bool` (getter)
- `close([Object? result])`
- `snapTo(int index)`

Controller — `NibBottomSheetController extends ChangeNotifier`:
- `isOpen: bool` (getter)
- `pendingSnap: int?` (getter) — snap index requested but not yet consumed
- `open()` — no-op if already open
- `close()` — no-op if already closed
- `snapTo(int index)` — requests an open sheet animate to snap `index`
- `consumePendingSnap()` — called by the surface once acted on

`NibBottomSheetScope` (`InheritedWidget`, accessed via `NibBottomSheetScope.of(context)`) — exposed to `content` subtree so buttons inside can dismiss/snap without a controller:
- `close: void Function([Object? result])`
- `snapTo: void Function(int index)`
- `isOpen: bool`

`animated`/`transition`: only the scrim/barrier's enter/exit fade routes through `NibMotion`/`NibPresence` (`animated: true` builds it, `false` builds none). The sheet's own position (enter/drag/snap/exit) is driven by an internal `AnimationController` + `SpringSimulation`, not `NibMotion` directly (can't wrap a continuously drag-controlled transform in NibMotion's declarative enter/animate/exit without fighting the gesture) — but its settle physics use `transition.spring` when animated.

Related types — `nib_bottom_sheet_types.dart` (pure math, no widgets):
- `kNibSheetMinExtent = 0.05`, `kNibSheetFlingVelocity = 2.0` (constants)
- `normalizeSnapExtents(List<double>? snapPoints) -> List<double>?`
- `clampInitialSnapIndex(int count, int? initialSnap) -> int`
- `resolveSnapTarget({required double currentExtent, required List<double> extents, required double velocity, required bool dismissible, double flingVelocity}) -> int?`

Usage (adapted from `bottom_sheet_examples.dart`):
```dart
// Imperative, content-sized
ElevatedButton(
  onPressed: () => showNibBottomSheet<void>(
    context,
    title: 'Share',
    content: Builder(
      builder: (sctx) => Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        ListTile(
          leading: const Icon(Icons.link),
          title: const Text('Copy link'),
          onTap: () => NibBottomSheetScope.of(sctx).close(),
        ),
      ]),
    ),
  ),
  child: const Text('Open sheet'),
);

// Snap points
showNibBottomSheet<void>(
  context,
  title: 'Nearby places',
  snapPoints: const [0.25, 0.5, 0.9],
  initialSnap: 1,
  animated: true,
  onSnapChanged: (i) => setState(() => snap = i),
  content: myList,
);

// Declarative + controller
final controller = NibBottomSheetController();
NibBottomSheet(
  controller: controller,
  title: 'Filters',
  snapPoints: const [0.4, 0.85],
  animated: true,
  transition: NibTransition.springGentle,
  trigger: const Text('Edit filters'),
  content: Builder(builder: (sctx) => TextButton(
    onPressed: () => NibBottomSheetScope.of(sctx).close(),
    child: const Text('Apply'),
  )),
);
controller.open();
```

---

### breadcrumb

Navigation trail that auto-collapses its middle items into an ellipsis overflow popover menu when there are too many crumbs or the viewport is too narrow.

`NibBreadcrumb(StatefulWidget)` constructor:
- `items: List<NibBreadcrumbItem>` (required) — trail root → current; the **last** item is the current page
- `maxVisibleItems: int? = null` — collapse once trail exceeds this count; `null` ⇒ collapse only when it doesn't fit the available width
- `itemsBeforeCollapse: int = 1` — leading crumbs kept when collapsed
- `itemsAfterCollapse: int = 1` — trailing crumbs kept when collapsed
- `separator: Widget? = null` — defaults to a chevron `›` icon
- `disabled: bool = false` — disables links, dims the trail (opacity 0.5)
- `overflowPlacement: NibPopoverPlacement = NibPopoverPlacement.bottom`
- `linkColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.mutedForeground`
- `currentColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.foreground`
- `separatorColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.mutedForeground`
- `fontSize: double? = null` — default `14`
- `itemPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? = null` — default `EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4)`
- `gap: double? = null` — icon↔label spacing, default `6`
- `animated: bool = false` — crumbs slide+fade in, staggered (`NibAnim(x: -8, opacity: 0)` → identity, delay += 40ms per position)
- `transition: NibTransition? = null` — null → `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 220))`
- `semanticLabel: String? = null` — default `'Breadcrumb'`

No controller. Falls back to a horizontal `SingleChildScrollView` as a last-resort overflow guard even after collapsing.

Related types — `nib_breadcrumb_types.dart`:
- `NibBreadcrumbItem` (data class): `label: String` (required), `icon: Widget? = null`, `onTap: VoidCallback? = null` — a non-null `onTap` on a non-last item renders a focusable link; the last item is always plain/current regardless of `onTap`
- `breadcrumbVisibleIndices({required int count, required bool collapsed, int before = 1, int after = 1}) -> List<int?>` — pure helper; `null` entries mark the ellipsis slot

Usage (adapted from `breadcrumb_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibBreadcrumb(
  items: [
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Home', onTap: () {}),
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Docs', onTap: () {}),
    const NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Breadcrumb'), // current page
  ],
)

// Long trail, collapsing, animated
NibBreadcrumb(
  maxVisibleItems: 4,
  animated: true,
  items: [
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Home', onTap: () {}),
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Workspace', onTap: () {}),
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'Projects', onTap: () {}),
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'nib_components', onTap: () {}),
    NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'lib', onTap: () {}),
    const NibBreadcrumbItem(label: 'nib_breadcrumb.dart'),
  ],
)
```

---

### button

Native, token-driven button with five visual variants, three size presets, loading/disabled states, and opt-in tap-pop animation. All variants share identical box geometry for a given size.

`NibButton(StatefulWidget)` constructor:
- `label: String? = null` — `null` renders icon-only (requires `semanticLabel`)
- `onPressed: VoidCallback?` (required) — `null` renders disabled
- `variant: NibButtonVariant = NibButtonVariant.primary`
- `size: NibButtonSize = NibButtonSize.md`
- `height: double? = null` — overrides size preset height (≥48 tap target still preserved independently)
- `width: double? = null` — `null` ⇒ content-sized (square if icon-only, full-width if `expand`)
- `padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? = null` — `null` ⇒ size preset's horizontal padding (zero if icon-only)
- `borderRadius: BorderRadius? = null` — `null` ⇒ pill radius if `pill`, else default radius; overrides `pill` when set
- `loading: bool = false` — shows `NibCircularLoader` in place of content, blocks taps
- `disabled: bool = false`
- `leadingIcon: Widget? = null`
- `trailingIcon: Widget? = null`
- `content: Widget? = null` — fully custom child replacing built-in icon/label layout; button still owns tap/ripple/focus/shape/sizing/padding/loading overlay
- `expand: bool = false` — stretch to parent's full width
- `pill: bool = false`
- `tooltip: String? = null`
- `semanticLabel: String? = null` — required when `label == null`
- `toggled: bool? = null` — `SemanticsFlag.isToggled` for toggle-like controls (e.g. `NibToggleGroup` segments); `null` omits the flag
- `focusNode: FocusNode? = null`
- `autofocus: bool = false`
- `animated: bool = false` — opt-in tap scale-pop (`NibAnim(scale: 0.94)` → identity, keyed by tap count)
- `transition: NibTransition? = null` — null → `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 120))`
- `loadingWidget: Widget? = null` — replaces the default spinner while `loading`
- `loadingText: String? = null` — text beside the loading indicator

Constructor asserts: needs content/label/an icon to render; icon-only (no label, no content) requires `semanticLabel`.

No controller (state is just an internal tap counter for animation replay + focus).

`animated`: wraps the whole button box in `NibMotion` keyed by tap count, tap = `NibAnim(scale: 0.94)` → `NibAnim.identity`; native ripple/hover/press feedback work regardless of `animated` (not motion-based).

Related types — `nib_button_types.dart`:
- `enum NibButtonVariant { primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive }`
- `enum NibButtonSize { sm, md, lg }` (sm ~36px/13px text, md ~44px/14px default, lg ~52px/16px)
- `NibButtonSizeMetrics` (data class): `height`, `fontSize`, `horizontalPadding`, `iconSize`, `gap` (all `double`); static `NibButtonSizeMetrics.of(NibButtonSize size)`

Usage (adapted from `button_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibButton(label: 'Click me', onPressed: () {})

NibButton(
  label: 'Delete',
  variant: NibButtonVariant.destructive,
  leadingIcon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline),
  onPressed: () {},
)

NibButton(
  label: 'Save',
  loading: isLoading,
  loadingText: 'Saving…',
  onPressed: save,
)

NibButton(onPressed: () {}, semanticLabel: 'Add', leadingIcon: const Icon(Icons.add))

NibButton(label: 'Pop', animated: true, onPressed: () {})
```

---

### card

Two distinct widgets: `NibCard` (generic content container with header/footer slots) and `NibFlipCard` (a two-face 3D flip card) — separate identities, not variants of one widget.

**`NibCard` (StatefulWidget)** constructor:
- `child: Widget? = null`
- `header: Widget? = null` — separated from `child`/`footer` by a `Divider`
- `footer: Widget? = null` — separated by a `Divider`
- `padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? = null` — default `EdgeInsets.all(16)`, applies to `child` only
- `borderRadius: BorderRadius? = null` — default `theme.radiusLg`
- `backgroundColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.card`
- `borderColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.border`
- `interactive: bool = false` — makes it tappable via internal `InkWell` (native ripple/hover/focus); `false` is a plain static container, zero gesture wrapper
- `onTap: VoidCallback? = null` — only used when `interactive`; `null` renders disabled
- `disabled: bool = false` — dims + disables regardless of `onTap`
- `semanticLabel: String? = null`
- `animated: bool = false` — opt-in press scale-pop, **only when `interactive`**
- `transition: NibTransition? = null` — null → `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 150))`

Constructor asserts at least one of `child`/`header`/`footer` is set. No controller. `animated && interactive`: wraps the box in `NibMotion` keyed by tap count, `NibAnim(scale: 0.97)` → identity, replayed each tap.

**`NibFlipCard` (StatefulWidget)** constructor:
- `front: Widget` (required)
- `back: Widget` (required)
- `isFlipped: bool? = null` — external control; `null` (default) ⇒ internally managed uncontrolled state
- `onFlippedChanged: ValueChanged<bool>? = null` — called on every tap (both controlled/uncontrolled) with the next state
- `flipAxis: Axis = Axis.horizontal` — `horizontal` rotates around vertical (Y) axis; `vertical` rotates around horizontal (X) axis
- `duration: Duration? = null` — default `Duration(milliseconds: 600)`
- `tappable: bool = true` — set `false` to drive purely via `isFlipped` externally
- `padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? = null` — default `EdgeInsets.all(16)`
- `borderRadius: BorderRadius? = null` — default `theme.radiusLg`
- `frontColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.card`
- `backColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.card`
- `borderColor: Color? = null` — default `theme.border`
- `frontSemanticLabel: String? = null`
- `backSemanticLabel: String? = null`

No `animated`/`transition` params — the flip itself always animates via `nib_motion`'s `NibFlip` widget (`front`/`back`/`flipAxis`/`duration`/`isFlipped` forwarded directly to it); there is no unanimated mode. No controller (same `expanded: bool?`-style controlled/uncontrolled pattern as `NibAccordion`, driven by `isFlipped`/`onFlippedChanged` instead of a `ChangeNotifier`).

Usage (adapted from `card_examples.dart`):
```dart
// Plain NibCard
const NibCard(child: Text('Plain content'))

// Interactive, animated, header+footer
NibCard(
  interactive: true,
  animated: true,
  onTap: () => setState(() => taps++),
  header: Row(children: [Icon(Icons.notifications_outlined), Text('Settings')]),
  footer: const Text('Manage in Settings'),
  child: Text('Tapped $taps times.'),
)

// Flip card, uncontrolled
const NibFlipCard(
  front: Center(child: Text('Tap to flip')),
  back: Center(child: Text('This is the back!')),
)

// Flip card, controlled externally
bool flipped = false;
NibFlipCard(
  isFlipped: flipped,
  tappable: false,
  front: const Center(child: Text('Front')),
  back: const Center(child: Text('Back')),
);
NibButton(label: 'Flip', onPressed: () => setState(() => flipped = !flipped));
```

---

### carousel

Swipeable carousel of slides built on a native `PageView`, with an optional dots/line page indicator, auto-play (paused during user interaction), a "peek" of adjacent slides, and infinite loop scrolling.

`NibCarousel(StatefulWidget)` constructor:
- `items: List<Widget>` (required)
- `controller: NibCarouselController? = null`
- `height: double = 220`
- `autoPlay: bool = false` — pauses while dragging; stops at last slide when `loop == false`
- `autoPlayInterval: Duration = const Duration(seconds: 4)`
- `loop: bool = false` — infinite wraparound scrolling
- `peekExtent: double = 0` — logical pixels of neighbouring slides revealed each side; converted to a `PageView.viewportFraction`; ignored if `viewportFraction` set
- `viewportFraction: double? = null` — explicit override (`1.0` = full width), takes precedence over `peekExtent`
- `indicatorStyle: NibCarouselIndicatorStyle = NibCarouselIndicatorStyle.dots`
- `padEnds: bool = true` — forwarded to `PageView.padEnds`
- `onPageChanged: ValueChanged<int>? = null` — called with the new logical index
- `animated: bool = false` — animates the active indicator dot
- `transition: NibTransition? = null` — null → `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 220))`

Also exports `NibCarouselDot` (`StatelessWidget`, public so tests can count them) — one per page indicator mark: `active: bool`, `color: Color`, `inactiveColor: Color`, `radius: double = 9999`, `style: NibCarouselIndicatorStyle = dots`, `animated: bool = false`, `transition: NibTransition? = null`.

Controller — `NibCarouselController extends ChangeNotifier`:
- `page: int` (getter) — current logical page index (0-based, independent of loop wrapping)
- `nextPage()` — advances one slide (wraps if looping; no-op at last slide otherwise)
- `previousPage()` — goes back one slide (wraps if looping; no-op at first slide otherwise)
- `animateToPage(int page)`
- `jumpToPage(int page)` — no animation

`animated`: only the active `NibCarouselDot` animates via `NibMotion` (keyed by `active`, `NibAnim(scale: 0.5, opacity: 0.4)` → identity when becoming active, replayed each page change); the `PageView` itself always uses native page-turn physics (`Curves.easeOutCubic`, 320ms), not NibMotion.

Related type — `enum NibCarouselIndicatorStyle { dots, line, none }` (dots = round, active wider+accent-coloured; line = short pills, active elongated; none = no indicator).

Usage (adapted from `carousel_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibCarousel(items: [Slide1(), Slide2(), Slide3()])

NibCarousel(
  items: slides,
  autoPlay: true,
  autoPlayInterval: const Duration(seconds: 3),
  loop: true,
  peekExtent: 32,
  animated: true,
  indicatorStyle: NibCarouselIndicatorStyle.line,
)

// External controller
final controller = NibCarouselController();
NibCarousel(items: slides, controller: controller, loop: true, indicatorStyle: NibCarouselIndicatorStyle.none);
controller.previousPage();
controller.nextPage();
Text('Page ${controller.page + 1} of ${slides.length}');
```
### checkbox

Tri-state (`false`/`true`/`null`) checkbox mirroring Flutter's `Checkbox` contract, with optional built-in label/description for a full-row tap target. `NibCheckbox` is a `StatelessWidget` — no internal mutable state, no controller.

`NibCheckbox` constructor:
- `value: bool?` (required) — must be non-null unless `tristate` is true
- `onChanged: ValueChanged<bool?>?` — null renders disabled
- `tristate: bool = false` — cycles `false → true → null → false` on tap when true
- `label: String?` — extends tap target to full row
- `description: String?` — secondary line under `label`
- `disabled: bool = false`
- `size: double?` — box side length, default 20
- `activeColor: Color?` — checked/indeterminate fill, default `NibTheme.primary`
- `contentPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry?` — default `EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8, horizontal: 4)`, only used when `label` is set
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default ~150ms ease
- `semanticLabel: String?` — defaults to `label`
- `focusNode: FocusNode?`
- `autofocus: bool = false`

No `NibCheckboxController` exists — the component has no persistent internal state to control externally (it's fully driven by `value`/`onChanged` like Flutter's own `Checkbox`).

`animated`/`transition`: only the check mark / dash icon inside the box is wrapped in `NibMotion` (`initial: NibAnim(scale: 0)`, `animate: NibAnim(scale: 1)`) when `animated` is true; `false` builds zero `NibMotion`.

Usage (adapted from `checkbox_examples.dart`):
```dart
bool checked = false;
NibCheckbox(value: checked, onChanged: (v) => setState(() => checked = v!));

// Tristate "select all" coordinating child checkboxes
NibCheckbox(
  value: allValue, // bool? computed from children
  tristate: true,
  label: 'Select all',
  description: 'Toggles every item below',
  onChanged: setAll,
);

// Animated, custom color/size
NibCheckbox(
  value: value, // bool?
  tristate: true,
  animated: true,
  size: 26,
  activeColor: NibTheme.of(context).accent,
  label: 'Sync across devices',
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => value = v),
);
```

No related enums/data classes.

---

### combobox

A text field fused with a filtered, keyboard-navigable dropdown of options — supports type-to-filter, single/multi-select (chips in-field), free-text commit, and sync or async (debounced) data sources.

`NibCombobox<T>` constructor:
- `options: List<NibComboboxOption<T>> = const []` — sync data source, ignored when `asyncOptionsLoader` is set
- `asyncOptionsLoader: NibComboboxOptionsLoader<T>?` — `Future<List<NibComboboxOption<T>>> Function(String query)`, debounced
- `multiSelect: bool = false`
- `allowFreeText: bool = false` — commit (Enter) unmatched text via `onFreeTextSubmitted`; if false, unmatched text reverts on close
- `debounceDuration: Duration = Duration(milliseconds: 300)`
- `onChanged: ValueChanged<T?>?` — single-select convenience, fires new value or null on clear
- `onSelectionChanged: ValueChanged<List<T>>?` — fires full selection in both modes
- `onFreeTextSubmitted: ValueChanged<String>?`
- `loading: bool = false` — consumer-forced loading indicator (independent of `asyncOptionsLoader`)
- `filter: NibComboboxFilter<T>?` — default `defaultComboboxFilter` (case-insensitive substring on label/subtitle); unused on async path
- `noResultsBuilder: WidgetBuilder?` — default muted "No results" row
- `placeholder: String = 'Select…'`
- `clearable: bool = true` — shows trailing ✕ when there's query or selection
- `disabled: bool = false`
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default short fade+scale+slide (~140ms)
- `maxDropdownHeight: double = 280`
- `controller: NibComboboxController<T>?`

`NibComboboxController<T> extends ChangeNotifier` (optional, owned internally if not passed):
- `selectedValues: List<T>` (unmodifiable, selection order)
- `selectedValue: T?` (first selected, or null)
- `query: String` (read-only mirror of field text)
- `isOpen: bool`
- `open()`, `close()`
- `selectOnly(T value)` — replaces whole selection (single-select)
- `toggle(T value)` — add/remove (multi-select)
- `clear()`
- `setQuery(String value, {bool notify = false})`

`animated`/`transition`: wraps the dropdown overlay `Material` card in `NibMotion` (`initial: NibAnim(opacity: 0, scale: 0.98, y: ±8)`, `animate: NibAnim(opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0)`) when true; `false` renders the card directly.

Usage (adapted from `combobox_examples.dart`):
```dart
// Minimal single-select
NibCombobox<String>(
  options: const [
    NibComboboxOption(value: 'apple', label: 'Apple', subtitle: 'Crisp and sweet'),
    NibComboboxOption(value: 'banana', label: 'Banana'),
  ],
  placeholder: 'Search fruit…',
  onChanged: (value) => print(value),
);

// Multi-select + async loader
NibCombobox<String>(
  multiSelect: true,
  placeholder: 'Type to search countries…',
  asyncOptionsLoader: (query) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 450));
    return [for (final c in countries) if (c.toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase())) NibComboboxOption(value: c, label: c)];
  },
  onSelectionChanged: (values) => debugPrint('$values'),
);

// Free text + controller + animated
final controller = NibComboboxController<String>();
NibCombobox<String>(
  controller: controller,
  options: fruits,
  allowFreeText: true,
  animated: true,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => committed = v),
  onFreeTextSubmitted: (text) => setState(() => committed = '"$text" (custom)'),
  noResultsBuilder: (context) => const Text('No preset match — press Enter.'),
);
```

Related types:
- `NibComboboxOption<T>` — `value: T`, `label: String`, `subtitle: String?`, `icon: Widget?`, `disabled: bool = false`
- `NibComboboxFilter<T>` — `typedef bool Function(NibComboboxOption<T> option, String query)`
- `NibComboboxOptionsLoader<T>` — `typedef Future<List<NibComboboxOption<T>>> Function(String query)`
- `defaultComboboxFilter<T>(option, query)` — case-insensitive substring match on label/subtitle
- `filterOptions<T>(options, query, filter)` — helper applying a filter

---

### command_palette

A `Cmd+K`/`Ctrl+K`-triggered (or programmatic) centered overlay wrapping a `child`, showing a searchable, keyboard-navigable, groupable, drill-down action list.

`NibCommandPalette` constructor:
- `child: Widget` (required) — wrapped subtree, never rebuilt by open/close (overlay is separate)
- `actions: List<NibCommandAction>` (required) — root-level action list
- `openShortcut: ShortcutActivator?` — default `NibCommandPalette.defaultOpenShortcut()` (Cmd+K on macOS/iOS, else Ctrl+K); fires regardless of focus
- `filter: NibCommandActionFilter?` — default `defaultCommandActionFilter`
- `placeholder: String = 'Type a command or search…'`
- `onActionSelected: ValueChanged<NibCommandAction>?` — fires for every leaf selection, in addition to that action's own `onSelected`
- `showRecent: bool = true` — shows "Recent" section at root level when query empty and history non-empty
- `maxRecent: int = 5`
- `animated: bool = false`
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default short fade+scale (~160ms)
- `controller: NibCommandPaletteController?`

Static: `NibCommandPalette.defaultOpenShortcut()` returns the platform-aware `SingleActivator`.

`NibCommandPaletteController extends ChangeNotifier` (optional, owned internally):
- `isOpen: bool`
- `recentActionIds: List<String>` (unmodifiable, most-recent-first)
- `open()`, `close()`, `toggle()`
- `recordUsed(String id, int maxRecent)` — moves id to front, trims to maxRecent

`animated`/`transition`: the palette content card (`NibCommandPaletteContent`, internal) wraps in `NibMotion` (`initial: NibAnim(opacity: 0, scale: 0.96, y: -8)`, `animate: identity`) when true.

Keyboard (built into `NibCommandPaletteContent`, not configurable): ↑/↓ move highlight, Enter/numpad-Enter activate, Escape pops one drill-down level or closes at root.

Usage (adapted from `command_palette_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibCommandPalette(
  actions: const [
    NibCommandAction(id: 'new-file', label: 'New File'),
    NibCommandAction(id: 'open-file', label: 'Open File'),
  ],
  onActionSelected: (action) => print(action.label),
  child: const Center(child: Text('Press Cmd+K / Ctrl+K')),
);

// Grouped, icons, shortcut hints, external controller-driven trigger button
final controller = NibCommandPaletteController();
NibCommandPalette(
  controller: controller,
  actions: const [
    NibCommandAction(id: 'new-file', label: 'New File', icon: Icon(Icons.note_add_outlined), shortcutLabel: '⌘N', group: 'File'),
    NibCommandAction(id: 'toggle-sidebar', label: 'Toggle Sidebar', icon: Icon(Icons.view_sidebar_outlined), group: 'View'),
  ],
  child: OutlinedButton(onPressed: controller.open, child: const Text('Open')),
);

// Nested branch + custom filter + animated
NibCommandPalette(
  animated: true,
  filter: (action, query) => action.label.toLowerCase().startsWith(query.toLowerCase()),
  actions: [
    NibCommandAction(
      id: 'change-theme', label: 'Change Theme', group: 'Preferences',
      children: [
        NibCommandAction(id: 'theme-light', label: 'Light', onSelected: () {}),
        NibCommandAction(id: 'theme-dark', label: 'Dark', onSelected: () {}),
      ],
    ),
  ],
  child: const SizedBox(height: 120),
);
```

Related types:
