A function-based, context-free toast/overlay API. `showNibToast(...)` shows a toast over the app's `Overlay` and returns its `id`; toasts are grouped and stacked by `position` (each position is an independent FIFO stack, capped at `_NibToastManager.maxVisible = 5` — the oldest is auto-dismissed past the cap). Not a widget placed in a tree — it's driven from anywhere (services, callbacks) once wrapped in `NibToaster`.

`showNibToast` function signature:
- `context: BuildContext?` — optional; if omitted, resolves the `Overlay` registered by an ancestor `NibToaster`. Asserts (in debug) if no overlay is found anywhere.
- `id: String?` — explicit id for dedup/dismiss targeting; auto-generated (`__nib_toast_<n>`) if omitted.
- `title: String?`, `message: String?` — default content (ignored if `content` is set).
- `content: Widget?` — fully custom body, replacing title/message layout.
- `variant: NibToastVariant = NibToastVariant.normal`.
- `icon: IconData?` — overrides `variant`'s default icon.
- `position: NibToastPosition = NibToastPosition.bottomRight`.
- `duration: Duration = Duration(seconds: 4)` — auto-dismiss delay; `Duration.zero` keeps it until manually dismissed.
- `actionLabel: String?` + `onAction: VoidCallback?` — optional inline action button; tapping it calls `onAction` then dismisses.
- `showCloseButton: bool = true`.
- `dismissible: bool = true` — enables horizontal swipe-to-dismiss.
- `onDuplicateTrigger: NibToastDuplicateBehavior = NibToastDuplicateBehavior.shake` — behavior when `id` is already showing.
- `animated: bool = false` — opt-in `nib_motion` enter/exit slide+fade (`NibPresence`/`NibMotion`) plus a size/height collapse reflow; `false` shows/hides instantly (still keeps drag-swipe transform and duplicate-shake wobble, which are plain `AnimationController`s, not `nib_motion`).
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 220))`.
- `onDismiss: VoidCallback?` — fires when the toast is actually removed.
- `padding: EdgeInsetsGeometry?` — default `EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 8, 12)`.
- `borderRadius: BorderRadiusGeometry?` — default `NibTheme.radiusLg`.
- `backgroundColor: Color?` — default `NibTheme.card`.
- Returns `String` (the resolved `id`).

Other public functions/widgets:
- `dismissNibToast(String id)` — dismisses one toast (no-op if not showing).
- `dismissAllNibToasts()` — dismisses every visible toast.
- `NibToaster({required Widget child})` — `StatefulWidget` wrapping the whole app (typically via `MaterialApp.builder`) so `showNibToast` works without a `context` anywhere. It hosts its own `Overlay` (app as base layer) and registers it with the internal manager singleton.

No public `NibToastController` — the internal `_NibToastManager` (a private singleton `ChangeNotifier`) is the de-facto controller but is not exported; all interaction goes through `showNibToast`/`dismissNibToast`/`dismissAllNibToasts`.

Duplicate-id behavior (`NibToastDuplicateBehavior`): `shake` (bump the existing toast's shake animation + restart its dismiss timer), `ignore` (no-op, return existing id), `replace` (overwrite all content fields on the existing toast + restart timer).

Usage (adapted from `toast_examples.dart`; requires wrapping the app):
```dart
MaterialApp(
  builder: (context, child) => NibToaster(child: child!),
  home: const HomePage(),
);

// anywhere, no context needed
showNibToast(
  title: 'Saved',
  message: 'Your changes are stored.',
  variant: NibToastVariant.success,
  animated: true,
);

// persistent with action
showNibToast(
  id: 'undo-delete',
  title: 'Item deleted',
  actionLabel: 'Undo',
  onAction: () => restoreItem(),
  position: NibToastPosition.bottomCenter,
  duration: Duration.zero,
  animated: true,
);
```

Related types (`nib_toast_types.dart`):
- `NibToastVariant` enum: `normal, success, error, warning, info`. Extension `NibToastVariantX`: `defaultIcon()` (null for `normal`; `check_circle_rounded`/`error_rounded`/`warning_amber_rounded`/`info_rounded` for the rest), `accent(NibTheme theme)` (foreground/success-green `0xFF16A34A`/destructive/warning-amber `0xFFF59E0B`/accent respectively).
- `NibToastPosition` enum: `topLeft, topCenter, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight`. Extension `NibToastPositionX`: `isTop` (bool), `alignment` (maps to `Alignment.*`), `enterOffset` (the slide-in `Offset` — left/right positions slide horizontally ±40px, centered positions slide vertically ±16px).
- `NibToastDuplicateBehavior` enum: `shake, ignore, replace`.

---

### toggle_group

A row of toggleable segments (single- or multi-select) where each segment is a `NibButton`, giving it focus/ripple/tap-target/semantics for free. Uses a roving-tabindex keyboard model: one tab stop for the group, arrow keys move focus between segments (wrapping, skipping disabled) without changing selection; Enter/Space/tap toggles the focused segment. `StatefulWidget`, generic over `T`.

`NibToggleGroup<T>` has two named constructors:

`NibToggleGroup<T>({...})` (single-select):
- `options: List<NibToggleOption<T>>` (required).
- `value: T?` (required) — current selection; tapping the already-selected segment deselects it to `null`.
- `onChanged: ValueChanged<T?>?`.
- `direction: Axis = Axis.horizontal`.
- `disabled: bool = false` — disables every segment regardless of per-option `disabled`.
- `size: NibButtonSize = NibButtonSize.md`.
- `itemWidth: double?` — fixed width per segment; `null` sizes to content.
- `fillWidth: bool = false` — horizontal segments share a finite parent width equally.
- `spacing: double?` — default 8.
- `animated: bool = false`.
- `transition: NibTransition?`.
- `semanticLabel: String?` — accessible name for the whole group.
- `autofocus: bool = false` — autofocuses the group's single tab stop.

`NibToggleGroup<T>.multiple({...})` (multi-select) — same params except:
- `values: Set<T>` (required, replaces `value`) — each segment toggles independently.
- `onChanged: ValueChanged<Set<T>>?` (replaces single `onChanged`).

- `direction: Axis = Axis.horizontal` — vertical stacks with wrapping instead of overflowing at narrow widths (horizontal uses `Wrap`).
- `animated: bool = false` — opt-in `nib_motion`: a newly-selected segment pops in via `NibMotion(initial: NibAnim(scale: 0.9), animate: NibAnim.identity)`; `false` builds zero `NibMotion`.
- `transition: NibTransition?` — default `NibTransition(duration: Duration(milliseconds: 150))`.

No `NibToggleGroupController` — fully controlled via `value`/`values` + `onChanged`.

Usage (adapted from `toggle_group_examples.dart`):
```dart
// Single-select, deselectable
String? align;
NibToggleGroup<String>(
  options: const [
    NibToggleOption(value: 'left', icon: Icon(Icons.format_align_left), semanticLabel: 'Align left'),
    NibToggleOption(value: 'center', icon: Icon(Icons.format_align_center), semanticLabel: 'Align center'),
    NibToggleOption(value: 'right', icon: Icon(Icons.format_align_right), semanticLabel: 'Align right'),
  ],
  value: align,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => align = v),
)

// Multi-select toolbar
Set<String> styles = {'bold'};
NibToggleGroup<String>.multiple(
  options: const [
    NibToggleOption(value: 'bold', label: 'Bold'),
    NibToggleOption(value: 'italic', label: 'Italic'),
    NibToggleOption(value: 'strike', label: 'Strikethrough', disabled: true),
  ],
  values: styles,
  animated: true,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => styles = v),
)
```

Related types (`nib_toggle_group_types.dart`):
- `NibToggleOption<T> { value: T, label: String?, icon: Widget?, disabled: bool = false, semanticLabel: String? }` — requires `label` and/or `icon`; requires `semanticLabel` when `label` is null (icon-only, asserted).

---

### validation

A supporting API of predefined `NibValidator` factory functions for `NibInput`/`NibTextarea` (and any `FormField<String>`), plus `compose` to chain several. `typedef NibValidator = String? Function(String? value)` — matches Flutter's `FormFieldValidator<String>` signature exactly, so they're interchangeable. Every format validator except `required` treats an empty value as valid (pair with `required` via `compose` for mandatory fields). All members live on `abstract final class NibValidators` (static-only, uninstantiable).

`NibValidators` static members:
- `compose(List<NibValidator> validators) → NibValidator` — runs validators in order, returns first non-null error or `null`.
- `required([String message = 'This field is required.']) → NibValidator` — fails on `null`, empty, or whitespace-only.
- `minLength(int length, [String? message]) → NibValidator` — fails when non-empty value is shorter than `length`. Default message: `'Must be at least $length characters.'`.
- `maxLength(int length, [String? message]) → NibValidator` — fails when value longer than `length`. Default message: `'Must be no more than $length characters.'`.
- `email([String message = 'Enter a valid email address.']) → NibValidator` — regex `^[\w.\-+%]+@[\w\-]+(\.[\w\-]+)+$`.
- `pattern(RegExp pattern, [String message = 'Invalid format.']) → NibValidator` — fails when non-empty value doesn't match `pattern`.
- `name([String message = 'Enter a valid name.']) → NibValidator` — regex `^[\p{L}][\p{L}'\- ]*$` (unicode), trims input first.
- `phone([String message = 'Enter a valid phone number.']) → NibValidator` — regex `^\+?[0-9\s\-().]{7,20}$`, trims input first.
- `password({int minLength = 8, bool requireUppercase = true, bool requireLowercase = true, bool requireNumber = true, bool requireSpecialChar = false}) → NibValidator` — checks each requirement in order, returns the first failing rule's specific message (e.g. `'Must contain an uppercase letter.'`); special-char set: `` [!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>_\-+=~`\[\];/] ``.

No controller/widget — pure static functions returning closures.

Usage (adapted from `form_examples.dart`):
```dart
NibInput(
  label: 'Email',
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  validator: NibValidators.compose([
    NibValidators.required(),
    NibValidators.email(),
  ]),
  onSaved: (v) => email = v,
)

NibInput(
  label: 'Password',
  obscureText: true,
  validator: NibValidators.compose([
    NibValidators.required(),
    NibValidators.password(),
  ]),
)

NibTextarea(
  label: 'Bio',
  minLines: 2,
  validator: NibValidators.minLength(10, 'Use at least 10 characters, or leave it empty.'),
)
```

## Theme Reference

`NibTheme` (`lib/src/theme/nib_theme.dart`) is an `@immutable class NibTheme extends
ThemeExtension<NibTheme>`. All fields are `required` and `final`; it implements
`copyWith`, `lerp`, `==`, and `hashCode`.

**Color tokens** (all `Color`):
- `background` — page/surface background
- `foreground` — primary text
- `card` — card surface background
- `cardForeground` — text on card
- `primary` — buttons, active states, links
- `primaryForeground` — text/icon on primary
- `secondary` — secondary button/surface background
- `secondaryForeground` — text on secondary
- `muted` — subtle/disabled backgrounds
- `mutedForeground` — placeholder/hint text
- `accent` — highlights
- `accentForeground` — text on accent
- `border` — borders/dividers
- `input` — input field border/background accent
- `ring` — focus ring color
- `destructive` — error/danger/delete actions

**Radius tokens** (all `double`):
- `radiusSm` — small radius (4 in both presets)
- `radiusDefault` — default radius (8 in both presets)
- `radiusLg` — large radius (12 in both presets)
- `radiusPill` — fully-rounded/pill radius (9999 in both presets)

**`NibTheme.light`** (const):
`background #FFFFFF, foreground #0A0A0A, card #FFFFFF, cardForeground #0A0A0A,
primary #02569B, primaryForeground #FFFFFF, secondary #F4F8FF,
secondaryForeground #02569B, muted #F1F5F9, mutedForeground #64748B,
accent #54C5F8, accentForeground #02569B, border #E2E8F0, input #E2E8F0,
ring #0175C2, destructive #EF4444`, radii `4/8/12/9999`.

**`NibTheme.dark`** (const):
`background #0A0A0A, foreground #FAFAFA, card #111111, cardForeground #FAFAFA,
primary #54C5F8, primaryForeground #0A0A0A, secondary #1A1F2E,
secondaryForeground #54C5F8, muted #1A1A1A, mutedForeground #94A3B8,
accent #0175C2, accentForeground #FFFFFF, border #1E2433, input #1E2433,
ring #54C5F8, destructive #EF4444`, radii `4/8/12/9999` (same as light).

**Registration:** register on `ThemeData.extensions`:
```dart
MaterialApp(
  theme: ThemeData(extensions: const [NibTheme.light]),
  darkTheme: ThemeData(extensions: const [NibTheme.dark]),
);
```
Customize by copying a preset:
```dart
ThemeData(extensions: [NibTheme.light.copyWith(primary: const Color(0xFF6D28D9))]);
```

**Fallback resolution — `NibTheme.of(BuildContext)`:**
```dart
static NibTheme of(BuildContext context) {
  final theme = Theme.of(context);
  return theme.extension<NibTheme>() ??
      (theme.brightness == Brightness.dark ? dark : light);
}
```
i.e.: look up the ambient `ThemeData`'s registered `NibTheme` extension; if absent,
pick the built-in `NibTheme.dark` or `NibTheme.light` constant purely from
`Theme.of(context).brightness` — components never need the extension registered to
render correctly in the right light/dark palette, registration only matters for
*custom* token values. This means a host app using plain `ThemeData.light()`/`.dark()`
(no extensions at all) still gets fully correct Nib light/dark styling automatically.

## Common Recipes

**1. Sign-in form (input + checkbox + button + validation, inside a `Form`):**
```dart
final formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
bool remember = false, loading = false;

Form(
  key: formKey,
  child: Column(children: [
    NibInput(
      label: 'Email',
      keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
      validator: NibValidators.compose([NibValidators.required(), NibValidators.email()]),
      onSaved: (v) => email = v,
    ),
    NibInput(
      label: 'Password',
      obscureText: true,
      validator: NibValidators.compose([NibValidators.required(), NibValidators.password()]),
      onSaved: (v) => password = v,
    ),
    NibCheckbox(value: remember, label: 'Remember me', onChanged: (v) => setState(() => remember = v!)),
    NibButton(
      label: 'Sign in',
      expand: true,
      loading: loading,
      onPressed: () async {
        if (!formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
        formKey.currentState!.save();
        setState(() => loading = true);
        await signIn(email, password);
        setState(() => loading = false);
      },
    ),
  ]),
)
```

**2. Sortable, selectable data table inside a resizable panel layout:**
```dart
final tableController = NibDataTableController<Employee>();
SizedBox(
  height: 500,
  child: NibResizablePanels(
    direction: Axis.horizontal,
    panels: [
      NibResizablePanel(initialSize: 0.22, minSize: 0.15, child: FilterSidebar()),
      NibResizablePanel(
        initialSize: 0.78,
        child: NibDataTable<Employee>(
          columns: columns, // List<NibDataColumn<Employee>>
          rows: employees,
          controller: tableController,
          selectionMode: NibDataTableSelectionMode.multi,
          animated: true,
          onSelectionChanged: (sel) => setState(() => selected = sel),
        ),
      ),
    ],
  ),
)
```

**3. Command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) wrapping the app shell, plus a manual trigger button:**
```dart
final paletteController = NibCommandPaletteController();
NibCommandPalette(
  controller: paletteController,
  animated: true,
  actions: [
    NibCommandAction(id: 'new-file', label: 'New File', icon: const Icon(Icons.note_add_outlined), group: 'File'),
    NibCommandAction(id: 'goto-settings', label: 'Settings', group: 'Navigate', onSelected: openSettings),
  ],
  onActionSelected: (a) => paletteController.recordUsed(a.id, 5),
  child: Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(actions: [
      IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.search), onPressed: paletteController.open),
    ]),
    body: const AppBody(),
  ),
)
```

**4. Themed, animated confirmation dialog (custom `NibTheme` registered at app root):**
```dart
MaterialApp(
  theme: ThemeData(extensions: [NibTheme.light.copyWith(primary: const Color(0xFF6D28D9))]),
  darkTheme: ThemeData(extensions: [NibTheme.dark.copyWith(primary: const Color(0xFFA78BFA))]),
  home: Builder(builder: (context) => NibButton(
    label: 'Delete account',
    variant: NibButtonVariant.destructive,
    onPressed: () async {
      final ok = await showNibAlertDialog(
        context,
        title: 'Delete account?',
        description: 'This cannot be undone.',
        severity: NibAlertSeverity.error,
        confirmText: 'Delete',
        animated: true,
      );
      if (ok == true) await deleteAccount();
    },
  )),
)
```

**5. Async-confirmed switch with toast feedback (requires `NibToaster` at app root):**
```dart
MaterialApp(builder: (context, child) => NibToaster(child: child!), home: const SettingsPage());

// inside SettingsPage:
NibSwitch(
  value: syncOn,
  loading: confirming,
  animated: true,
  label: 'Sync across devices',
  onChanged: (next) async {
    setState(() => confirming = true);
    try {
      await api.setSync(next);
      setState(() { syncOn = next; confirming = false; });
      showNibToast(title: 'Saved', variant: NibToastVariant.success, animated: true);
    } catch (_) {
      setState(() => confirming = false);
      showNibToast(title: 'Failed to save', variant: NibToastVariant.error, animated: true);
    }
  },
)
```

**6. Filter toolbar: select + combobox + toggle group driving a list:**
```dart
NibSelect<String>(
  options: const [NibSelectOption(value: 'all', label: 'All statuses'), NibSelectOption(value: 'open', label: 'Open')],
  value: status,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => status = v),
),
NibCombobox<String>(
  multiSelect: true,
  options: tagOptions,
  placeholder: 'Filter by tag…',
  onSelectionChanged: (tags) => setState(() => selectedTags = tags),
),
NibToggleGroup<String>.multiple(
  options: const [NibToggleOption(value: 'mine', label: 'Assigned to me'), NibToggleOption(value: 'starred', label: 'Starred')],
  values: quickFilters,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => quickFilters = v),
),
```

**7. Date-range popover trigger feeding a paginated table:**
```dart
NibPopover(
  placement: NibPopoverPlacement.bottom,
  content: Builder(builder: (pctx) => NibDatePicker(
    mode: NibDatePickerMode.range,
    displayMode: NibDatePickerDisplayMode.inline,
    animated: true,
    onRangeChanged: (r) {
      setState(() => range = r);
      if (r?.isComplete ?? false) NibPopoverScope.of(pctx).close();
    },
  )),
  trigger: NibButton(label: range == null ? 'Pick date range' : '${range!.start} – ${range!.end}', onPressed: () {}),
),
NibPagination(
  currentPage: page,
  totalPages: totalPages,
  animated: true,
  onPageChanged: (p) => setState(() => page = p),
),
```

**8. OTP verification with loading state and toast on failure:**
```dart
NibOtpInput(
  length: 6,
  animated: true,
  loading: verifying,
  errorText: error,
  autoFocus: true,
  onCompleted: (code) async {
    setState(() { verifying = true; error = null; });
    final ok = await verifyCode(code);
    setState(() => verifying = false);
    if (!ok) {
      setState(() => error = 'Incorrect code');
      showNibToast(title: 'Verification failed', variant: NibToastVariant.error);
    }
  },
)
```

## Known Pitfalls

- **`animated: false` means zero `NibMotion`-family widgets are built at all** — not merely "animation configured off." This is a hard invariant across the whole library, checked in the source test suite with `find.byType(NibMotion), findsNothing`. When generating code, don't assume an unanimated component still has a (disabled) `NibMotion` in its tree — it has none.
- **Not every visual movement is gated by `animated`.** Continuous/gesture-driven motion (drag-follows-pointer on `NibSlider`/`NibResizablePanels` handles, `NibCircularLoader`'s spin, toast swipe-to-dismiss and duplicate-shake wobble, `NibTabs`' indicator glide/pager slide/height reflow) uses a raw `AnimationController`/`SpringSimulation`, never `nib_motion`, and animates regardless of `animated`. Only *discrete state-change* animation (enter/exit, pop-in, cross-fade) routes through `nib_motion` and is what `animated` toggles.
- **`NibFlipCard` has no `animated`/`transition` params at all** — the flip always animates via `nib_motion`'s `NibFlip`; there is no static mode. Every other component with visible motion has an opt-out.
- **`NibCard`'s `animated` only takes effect when `interactive: true`** — a non-interactive card has no tap-driven state to animate, so `animated` alone does nothing.
- **Controller disposal ownership**: when you omit a component's `<Component>Controller` param, the widget creates, owns, and disposes it. When you pass your own instance, the widget never disposes it — you must call `.dispose()` yourself (typically in your own `State.dispose()`). Getting this backwards either leaks a controller or double-disposes/uses-after-dispose one the widget also thinks it owns.
- **`NibTheme.of` fallback is by ambient `Brightness`, not a fixed default.** A host app that never registers the `NibTheme` extension still renders fully correct light/dark Nib styling automatically (`NibTheme.light`/`.dark` picked from `Theme.of(context).brightness`) — registering the extension is only needed to *customize* tokens, never required for correctness.
- **`lib/src/overlay/` (`NibAnchoredOverlay`, `overlay_positioning.dart`, `measure_size.dart`) is internal, shared plumbing — not exported from the public barrel `lib/nib_components.dart`.** It's used internally by popover, hover_card, context_menu, navigation_menu, date_picker, and bottom_sheet for viewport-aware anchored positioning. Don't reference `NibAnchoredOverlay` from generated user code; it's not part of the supported API surface even though it's technically reachable via a deep import.
- **Two pre-existing, expected `flutter analyze` findings that are NOT bugs — don't "fix" them if seen in the source:**
  - `invalid_dependency` on the package's `pubspec.yaml` `nib_motion: path: ...` entry — expected while `nib_components` and `nib_motion` are developed side by side pre-publish (path dependency, not yet a published version constraint).
  - `prefer_initializing_formals` (info) on `NibDataTableController`'s constructor (`sort` param manually assigned to `_sort` rather than via `this.sort`) — a locked, intentional design choice per the original implementation plan, not an oversight.
  - See `/home/occ/Projects/Nib/ComponetsNib/nib_components/CLAUDE.md` for the canonical statement of both.
- **Several components assert mutually-exclusive constructor params rather than silently picking one**: `NibSelect` requires exactly one of `options`/`groups`; `NibCombobox`/`NibInput`/`NibTextarea` reject passing both `controller` and `initialValue`/seed value together. These are debug-mode `assert`s — passing both (or neither, where required) throws at construction, not a silent fallback.
- **`NibResizablePanels` requires bounded constraints on both axes** (wrap in `SizedBox`/`Expanded`/similar) — it lays out via a custom `RenderObject` that needs a finite main-axis extent to distribute fractional panel sizes; an unbounded parent (e.g. bare `Column`) will misbehave or assert.
- **`NibTabs` owns the single vertical scroll for its whole region** (`header` + pinned bar + active panel + `footer` in one `CustomScrollView`). Don't nest it inside another vertical `ListView`/`SingleChildScrollView` — put "content above" in `header` and "content below" in `footer` instead, per the component's own contract note.
- **`NibSkeleton` follows a "one authored tree" rule**: wrap the real, already-built widget tree in `child` and let the auto-detector shade it — don't hand-author a parallel skeleton tree. Use `NibSkeletonBone` to override a subtree the detector can't shape correctly, and `NibSkeletonIgnore` to force a subtree to always render as-is. `StatefulWidget` children are mounted for real (real lifecycle/tickers) but their paint output is swapped for bone paint commands — this preserves chrome like `NibCard`'s `DecoratedBox` while still boning its content.
- **`showNibToast` needs a route to the app's `Overlay`**: either wrap the app in `NibToaster` (recommended — lets you call `showNibToast` with no `context` from anywhere, e.g. a service class) or always pass a `context` explicitly. Calling it with neither, and no ancestor `NibToaster`, asserts in debug mode.
- **Overlay-style APIs (`showNibDialog`, `showNibAlertDialog`, `showNibBottomSheet`, `showNibContextMenu`, `showNibToast`) are imperative functions, not widgets** — they don't take `controller` params the way declarative siblings (`NibDialog`, `NibBottomSheet`) do; their returned `Future`/handle is the entire control surface. Don't look for a `NibToastController`/`NibAlertController` — none exists by design.
- **Per-component default animation durations are not globally uniform** — they range roughly 120ms (button tap-pop, resizable-panel handle) to 250ms (tabs); always check the specific component's documented default `transition` rather than assuming one shared constant.
- **`NibDatePickerController`'s runtime `minSelectable`/`maxSelectable` take precedence over the widget's `minDate`/`maxDate`** when both are set — useful for dynamically narrowing bounds (e.g. disabling past dates after a first selection) without rebuilding the whole widget with new constructor params.
